news.title: Summer transfers 2026: All the Chelsea ins, outs and new contracts so far
news.title_zh: 2026 年夏季转会：迄今为止切尔西的所有进场、出局和新合同
news.body_en: With the 2026 summer transfer window now open, we keep you updated with all the deals done so far this summer... Versatile midfielder Barco arrived from Strasbourg, signing a contract until 2033. He has previous experience of English football with Brighton. The 29-year-old Spaniard joined Chelsea early in August following four seasons with Rayo Vallecano. The experienced England international joined the Blues in August after leaving Brentford, agreeing a two-year deal at Stamford Bridge. Lacroix made the short journey from Crystal Palace to Chelsea towards the end of July, fresh from his involvement for France at the 2026 World Cup. Lacroix's deal lasts until 2032. Chelsea managed to secure the services of one of the best goalkeepers in the world when they signed the 2022 World Cup winner from Aston Villa on a contract which will run until 2029. The Italian international became our first signing of the summer when he joined on a permanent deal from Atalanta at the start of July. Palestra signed a contract through to 2033. The winger's move to Chelsea was first confirmed in March 2025, before officially completing his move from Sporting Lisbon this summer. The Portuguese teenager signed a contract until 2034. England international Morgan Rogers signed from Aston Villa in July 2026, penning a contract until 2033. He has played 22 times for the Three Lions, including at this summer's World Cup, and established himself as one of the top attacking talents in the Premier League. Dastan Satpayev completed a transfer to Chelsea after his 18th birthday, having been a part of our pre-season tour in Australia and Asia. He subsequently joined Burnley on loan. Joining from Brighton and Hove Albion, where he had impressed in recent seasons, striker Welbeck became our fifth signing of the summer. His contract runs to 2028. 18-year-old Bettoni joined from Wigan Athletic on a contract until 2030. The attacking midfielder featured 27 times for the Latics last season, scoring four goals. Osborne, 18, joined from Hearts in Scotland and put pen to paper on a contract with the Blues until 2030. Toby Bell signed his first professional contract. The goalkeeper made his Under-18 debut in November 2024 and has represented England throughout his development pathway. The young winger commited his long-term future to Chelsea by signing a new contract until 2032, shortly before agreeing a loan switch to swap London for Lisbon in the 2026/27 season with a spell at Sporting. Academy attacker Sol Gordon signed a new contract until 2029. Having joined Chelsea's development centre at Under-8 level, Gordon has progressed through the Academy ranks to become a regular for our Under-18s and has also featured for the Blues' Under-21s. Academy striker Jashayde Greenwood signed his first professional contract with the club following his 17th birthday and after a successful maiden campaign at Chelsea. Harrison, an Academy midfielder who established himself as a regular for our Under-21s last season as we lifted the Premier League 2 title, signed a new contract until 2029. He later joined Wimbledon on loan. Our midfielder signed his first professional contract with the Blues following his 17th birthday. He has been with our Academy since Under-8s level. Academy defender Osagie signed a new contract keeping him at the club until 2029. He established himself as an important member of our Under-21 side last season. Ahead of the campaign starting, Joao Pedro signed a new contract with Chelsea until 2034. The Brazilian netted 20 goals in his debut season at the Bridge and was voted our Player of the Year. Before joining Dulwich Hamlet on loan, Academy goalkeeper Sands signed a new three-year contract. After captaining Chelsea Under-18s to victory in the Under-18 Premier League national final in 2026, the centre-back signed his first professional contract with the Blues. The 19-year-old Academy player embarked on his first loan in August 2026, joining Ligue 1 side Strasbourg for the forthcoming campaign. The defender, who has played 71 times for the Blues, joined Napoli on loan for the season. Disasi has joined fellow Premier League side Crystal Palace for this season, having spent the second half of last term with West Ham United. The Argentina international joined Aston Villa on loan for 2026/27 having scored eight goals in 43 appearances in his first season at Stamford Bridge. Academy midfielder Harrison signed for League One side AFC Wimbledon for the season, embarking on his maiden loan away from the Bridge. The goalkeeper has moved to Strasbourg on loan for the season. The 17-year-old winger departed on his maiden loan spell in the senior game, signing for Portsmouth ahead of the Championship season starting. Young goalkeeper Max Merrick embarked on his third loan away from the Bridge by joining Hartlepool United of the National League for the season. He has been in our first team matchday squad on 11 occasions in recent years. Chelsea Academy defender Murray-Campbell, who made his senior Blues debut against Shamrock Rovers in the 2024/25 UEFA Conference League, will spend the coming season gaining further experience of men's football with KV Kortrijk in the Belgian first division. The defender has joined Notts County of League One for the 2026/27 campaign, following his loan spell with Swansea City last term. The young goalkeeper signed a new contract until 2029 and joined non-league side Dulwich Hamlet on a youth loan. The defender will spend this season in Spain, after joining Real Sociedad on loan. He has made seven appearances for Chelsea since arriving from Strasbourg. After completing his transfer to Chelsea, the Kazakh attacker moved to Burnley on loan for the season. Walsh, who played four games for our senior team in 2025 including as a 16-year-old, will spend the season on loan at Wigan Athletic in League One this season. The American has made a season-long loan move to Championship side Preston North End, having previously represented Watford on loan in that division. Wilson embarked on his first loan in senior football in July 2026, joining newly-promoted League Two side Rochdale for the forthcoming campaign. The winger left for Ipswich Town after a season playing for our Academy sides. The teenager came through the ranks at the Chelsea Academy from Under-8s level and featured for our Under-18s in pre-season. He has now joined Reading. Chalobah completed a permanent transfer to Como in August, bringing his time as a Chelsea player to an end after nearly two decades with the Blues. He won four trophies, having established himself in our first team ahead of the 2021/22 campaign. The Spaniard left for Real Madrid after four successful seasons at Stamford Bridge during which he won the Club World Cup and the UEFA Conference League, as well as helping Spain triumph in the 2024 Euros. Delap departed for Nottingham Forest after 14 months with Chelsea. The striker played 41 times for the Blues, including six of our seven games during last summer's victorious FIFA Club World Cup campaign. The Chelsea striker has joined Swiss club Servette on a permanent deal. Fofana signed for the Blues from Molde in January 2023, scoring 17 goals and providing three assists during his time at the Bridge and on loan. The winger made his loan move to Everton permanent this summer, departing Chelsea after progressing through our Academy and making 37 appearances for the senior team. The versatile defender spent 13 years in our Academy having joined as an Under-8. He was released at the end of the 2025/26 season, which he spent on loan at AFC Wimbledon. The Senegal striker completed a permanent transfer to fellow Premier League side Aston Villa. Jackson was part of the Chelsea squads that won the Conference League and Club World Cup, scoring against Real Betis in the final of the former. The attacking midfielder made a permanent move to France with Ligue 1 club Strasbourg, after spending last season on loan with Cardiff City, where he helped them earn promotion to the Championship. The Academy forward completed a permanent move to Championship side West Bromwich Albion after impressing on loan at Peterborough last season. Morgan had returned to Chelsea, where he spent time in our Academy as a youngster, in February 2023. Olise also moved on after a decade with the club. Signed by Chelsea as an Under-9, Olise featured throughout the age groups in our Academy and was named in the first-team squad for our UEFA Conference League trip to Astana during the 2024/25 season. Runham sealed a permanent switch to Ipswich Town having spent the second half of last season on loan with the Tractor Boys. The move brought the attacking midfielder's long association with Chelsea to an end. Rak-Sakyi made four first-team appearances, all in our triumphant Conference League campaign, having developed through our Academy. The midfield was released at the expiry of his contract. The midfielder made 47 appearances for Chelsea and became a full Brazil international during his three years as a Blue. He has now completed a permanent transfer to Manchester United. The Finnish youth international's six-year spell at Chelsea ended this summer. He made his first-team debut in an FA Cup win over Leeds in March 2024, and also featured in the Premier League when he came on in a home victory against Tottenham. The young defender spent the second half of last season on loan at Brentford, featuring mainly for their reserve side, and made that switch permanent over the summer.

年世界杯。拉克鲁瓦的合同持续到2032年。切尔西从阿斯顿维拉签下了这位2022年世界杯冠军得主，合同期到2029年，从而成功地获得了世界上最好的门将之一的效力。这位意大利国脚于7月初从亚特兰大永久签约，成为我们今年夏天的第一笔签约。帕莱斯特拉签订的合同到2033年为止。这位边锋于2025年3月首次确认转会至切尔西，然后在今年夏天正式完成从里斯本竞技的转会。这位葡萄牙少年的合同到2034年为止。英格兰国脚摩根·罗杰斯于2026年7月从阿斯顿维拉签约，合同到2033年为止。他已经为三狮军团出场22次，包括今年夏天的世界杯，并确立了自己作为英超联赛顶级进攻天才之一的地位。达斯坦·萨帕耶夫 个月后前往诺丁汉森林。这位前锋为蓝军出场 41 次，其中包括去年夏天赢得国际足联俱乐部世界杯期间的七场比赛中的六场。这位切尔西前锋已与瑞士俱乐部塞尔维特签订永久合同。福法纳于2023年1月从莫尔德加盟蓝军，在蓝桥和租借期间打进17球并贡献3次助攻。这位边锋于今年夏天永久租借至埃弗顿，在完成青训并为成年队出场 37 次后离开切尔西。这位多才多艺的后卫在我们的青训营度过了 13 年，作为 8 岁以下球员加入。他在2025/26赛季结束后被释放，并被租借到亚足联温布尔登。这位塞内加尔前锋完成了永久转会至英超球队阿斯顿维拉。杰克逊是切尔西队赢得分区联赛和世俱杯冠军的一员，他在前者的决赛中对阵皇家贝蒂斯时进球。这位攻击型中场球员上赛季被租借到卡迪夫城并帮助他们升级到英冠，随后他永久转会至法国法甲俱乐部斯特拉斯堡。这位青训前锋上赛季租借到彼得伯勒队给人留下了深刻的印象，之后永久转会至英冠球队西布罗姆维奇队。 赛季前往阿斯塔纳的欧足联会议联赛的一线队阵容。鲁纳姆在上赛季后半段被租借到拖拉机男孩队后，永久转会到伊普斯维奇镇。此举结束了这位攻击型中场与切尔西的长期合作关系。拉克-萨基在我们青训学院的培养下，在我们凯旋的分区联赛中四次代表一线队出场。 这名中场球员在合同到期后被释放。这位中场球员为切尔西出场 47 次，并在效力蓝军的三年里成为一名正式的巴西国脚。他现在已经完成了向曼联的永久转会。这位芬兰青年国脚在切尔西的六年任期于今年夏天结束。 2024年3月，他在足总杯战胜利兹联的比赛中完成一线队首秀，并在主场战胜托特纳姆热刺的英超联赛中出场。这位年轻的后卫上赛季后半段被租借到布伦特福德，主要为预备队效力，并在夏天永久转会。

news.title: Analysis: Flying wingers, why possession isn't always king and Joao Pedro at it again
news.title_zh: 分析：飞翔的边锋，为什么控球并不总是王道，而若奥·佩德罗又开始了
news.body_en: This was a different Chelsea than we have been accustomed to over the years, but it was definitely effective. We look at how Xabi Alonso masterminded the Blues' 4-3 win over Brighton & Hove Albion. With 14 goals in our first three games this season, it's fair to say life under Alonso has been exciting so far. Chelsea raced to a 3-0 lead against Brighton at Stamford Bridge, courtesy of goals from Romeo Lavia, Pedro Neto and Joao Pedro. Brighton reduced the deficit to 3-2 before a moment of pure class from the rejuvenated Cole Palmer meant the Seagulls' 90+6-minute header was a mere consolation. Here we take a look at how the game was won... It is often said, 'Possession is king' when the importance of dominating the ball in modern football comes up in conversation. On Saturday, Chelsea proved that isn't always the case. Our 4-3 victory over Brighton saw the Blues have just 26 per cent possession across the 90 minutes, with our 225 passes attempted and 152 passes completed Chelsea's lowest figures since Opta records began during the 2003/24 season. But this wasn't a case where the Blues were under the kosh throughout or where the stats were skewed based on a second-half onslaught; our possession was at 30 per cent at half-time when we enjoyed a 3-1 lead. This was a calculated game plan from new manager Xabi Alonso, and it worked. The 'xG race' graphic below shows how each team's cumulative expected goals (xG) total builds throughout a match. The chart tracks the quality of chances created over time, rather than just the actual scoreline, with a steep rise highlighting a high-quality chance. The graphic highlights how the Blues were good value for their 3-0 lead because of the quality of chances they created. These were not pot-shots from distance which fortuitously came off; all three finishes came within ten yards of the Brighton goal. Alonso decided he would allow Brighton to have more of the ball and would then look to utilise our counter-attacking threat and the outstanding quality of our front three in the final third. When Sky Sports revealed the Blues had enjoyed less than a third of possession during the first half, it would have come as a shock to many because the hosts had clearly been the better team and had carried the greater threat. Alonso acknowledged post-match that after a 'brilliant first half an hour', his team 'played too much with the result in mind' and were too deep at times but understandably highlighted they are still in a process of improvement, with this just his third competitive game in charge of the Blues. But across the whole 90 minutes, Chelsea were good value for the win and the tactical plan paid off. Chelsea's directness was clear from the off and was backed up by the statistics post-match. The Blues utilised the forward passing ability of their deeper players, the speed of their wing-backs and the power and pace of Joao Pedro up top to great effect as we regularly got up the field quickly. The fact Emi Martinez made the second-highest 'completed passes in the opposition third', just one behind Morgan Rogers and level with Joao Pedro, shows just how much the Blues looked to go from back to front with speed. Based on Opta data, new goalkeeper Martinez only made one short pass from his 38 passes, meaning 97.4 per cent of his deliveries were considered 'long passes'. Only Mark Schwarzer against Liverpool in 2014 has a higher percentage (100 per cent from 31) for Chelsea since Opta started collecting data in 2003/04. Petr Cech was the other to go above 97 per cent on three occasions. This wasn't a goalkeeper just hitting and hoping, though; Martinez was regularly picking out the runs of players like Joao Pedro and Pedro Neto. Martinez passing to Joao Pedro was the most used combination between any Chelsea players, with eight. And, according to Opta, Martinez became just the second Chelsea goalkeeper to create two or more clear chances in a Premier League game since they started collecting data, with Robert Sanchez also providing two against the same opposition last season. Only Wayne Hennessy has ever created more, with three for Burnley against Manchester United in December 2021. The decision to go direct would have been influenced by the fact Alonso had the option of playing one of the fastest players in the Premier League in Pedro Neto - he recorded the eighth quickest time for the whole of the 2025/26 campaign at 22.6 miles per hour. And Jorrel Hato has already shown this season he is no slouch either. Despite lining up as wing-backs in the static formation graphic, and often being deep in our half when defending against Brighton attacks, Neto was often one of our most advanced players and Hato, although seen as a defender by trade, was a real attacking threat, too. It was Neto's cross from the byline which won the corner that ultimately led to Romeo Lavia's opening goal - a set-piece he also delivered. The Portugal international then ran from close to 30 yards out to get on the end of Morgan Rogers' cross for the second goal, and probably would have scored the third, had Joao Pedro not got to the ball first. That third goal was indicative of the two wing-backs' attacking threat throughout the game. They were both inside the Chelsea penalty area when Hato started the move. The Netherlands international then ran almost the length of the pitch before sliding the ball into the box. Neto had matched Hato stride for stride on the opposite side of the pitch and was there ready to collect the pass, had Joao Pedro not controlled and finished expertly. With Marco Palestra - the player judged to be the quickest in the Serie A last season - still to return from injury, one suspects this won't be the last time we see Chelsea wing-backs' pace posing a counter-attacking threat this season. Joao Pedro appears to be getting better and better every week. The forward made an immediate impact at Chelsea, finishing the season with 20 goals in all competitions and claiming the club's Player of the Season Award. But with the creative talents of Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers behind him, the Brazilian appears to have gone up another level. On Saturday, Joao scored one and set up another. In truth, he probably should have scored twice, as he uncharacteristically shot wide from inside the penalty area. But it isn't just the goal contributions that make him special. It is his all-round play. It's the game-high figure of 13 duels that he won, it's the work rate he showed out of possession, it's every part of his game. Chelsea have a special forward on their hands and fans will be excited to see the level he can reach over the coming years.
news.body_zh: 这与我们多年来所习惯的切尔西不同，但这绝对是有效的。我们来看看哈维·阿隆索如何策划蓝军 4-3 战胜布莱顿。我们本赛季前三场比赛打进了 14 个进球，可以公平地说，到目前为止，阿隆索麾下的生活令人兴奋。凭借罗密欧·拉维亚、佩德罗·内托和若昂·佩德罗的进球，切尔西在斯坦福桥以 3-0 领先布莱顿。布莱顿将比分差距缩小到 3-2，但恢复活力的科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 打出精彩表现，意味着海鸥队 90+6 分钟的头球只是一个安慰。下面我们来看看这场比赛是如何获胜的……当谈到现代足球中控球的重要性时，人们常说“控球为王”。周六，切尔西证明情况并非总是如此。我们以 4-3 战胜布莱顿，蓝军在 90 分钟内的控球率仅为 26%，我们的传球尝试次数为 225 次，传球次数为 152 次，这是切尔西自 2003/24 赛季 Opta 记录开始以来的最低数据。但这并不是蓝军自始至终都处于困境的情况，也不是统计数据因下半场的猛烈进攻而出现偏差的情况。半场结束时我们的控球率达到了30%，当时我们以3-1领先。这是新任主帅哈维·阿隆索精心策划的比赛计划，而且它奏效了。下面的“xG 竞赛”图表显示了每支球队在整场比赛中的累积预期进球 (xG) 总数如何形成。该图表跟踪随着时间的推移创造的机会的质量，而不仅仅是实际的得分线，急剧上升突出了高质量的机会。该图突显了蓝军如何凭借创造的高质量机会而以 3-0 领先。这些并不是从远处偶然射出的射击；而是从远处射出的。所有三个进球都距离布莱顿球门不到十码。阿隆索决定让布莱顿拥有更多控球权，然后在进攻三区利用我们的反击威胁和前场三人的出色表现。当天空体育透露蓝军在上半场的控球率不足三分之一时，很多人都会感到震惊，因为主队显然是更好的球队，并且带来了更大的威胁。阿隆索赛后承认，在“精彩的前半个小时”之后，他的球队“打得太注重结果”，有时深度太深，但可以理解的是，他强调他们仍在进步的过程中，这只是他执教蓝军的第三场正式比赛。但在整个 90 分钟内，切尔西的胜利非常有价值，战术计划得到了回报。切尔西的直接性从一开始就很明显，并得到了赛后统计数据的支持。蓝军利用了更深的球员的向前传球能力、边后卫的速度以及若昂·佩德罗的力量和速度，在我们经常快速上场的情况下发挥了巨大的作用。事实上，埃米·马丁内斯在“对方第三区完成传球”中排名第二，仅落后摩根·罗杰斯一球，与若昂·佩德罗持平，这表明蓝军从后到前的速度有多快。根据 Opta 的数据，新门将马丁内斯在 38 次传球中仅完成 1 次短传，这意味着他的传球中有 97.4% 被认为是“长传”。自 Opta 从 2003/04 赛季开始收集数据以来，只有 2014 年对阵利物浦的马克·施瓦泽 (Mark Schwarzer) 为切尔西取得了更高的命中率（从 31 分到 100%）。切赫是另一位三次超过 97% 的人。不过，这并不是一个只是射门并希望的守门员；他是一名守门员。马丁内斯经常挑选若奥·佩德罗和佩德罗·内托等球员的跑动。马丁内斯传球给若昂·佩德罗是切尔西球员中最常用的组合，共有八次。据 Opta 报道，自开始收集数据以来，马丁内斯成为第二位在英超比赛中创造两次或更多明显机会的切尔西门将，罗伯特·桑切斯上赛季在对阵同一对手时也创造了两次以上机会。只有韦恩·轩尼诗创造了更多的进球，2021年12月伯恩利对阵曼联的比赛中创造了三个进球。阿隆索可以选择与英超联赛中速度最快的球员之一佩德罗·内托比赛，这一事实影响了他直接上场的决定——他以每小时22.6英里的速度创下了整个2025/26赛季第八快的成绩。 乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato）本赛季也已经证明了他的实力。尽管在静态阵型图中担任边后卫，并且在防守布莱顿的进攻时经常深入我们半场，但内托通常是我们最先进的球员之一，而哈托虽然被视为防守球员，但也是真正的进攻威胁。正是内托从底线传中赢得了角球，最终为罗密欧·拉维亚打进了首个进球——他也完成了这个定位球。这位葡萄牙国脚随后从近30码处跑出，接到摩根·罗杰斯的传中，打进了第二个进球，如果不是若奥·佩德罗先得球，他很可能会打进第三个球。第三个进球体现了两名边后卫整场比赛的进攻威胁。当哈托开始动作时，他们都在切尔西禁区内。这位荷兰国脚随后跑了几乎整个球场，然后将球滑入禁区。内托在球场的另一侧与哈托齐步并进，并准备好接球，如果若奥·佩德罗没有控制住并熟练地完成射门。由于马尔科·帕莱斯特拉——上赛季被认为是意甲联赛中速度最快的球员——仍未从伤病中恢复，人们怀疑这不会是我们本赛季最后一次看到切尔西边后卫的速度构成反击威胁。若昂·佩德罗似乎每周都变得越来越好。这位前锋在切尔西立即产生了影响，在整个赛季结束时在所有比赛中打进 20 个进球，并获得了俱乐部的赛季最佳球员奖。但在科尔·帕尔默（Cole Palmer）和摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）的创意才华的支持下，这位巴西人似乎又上升了一个台阶。周六，若昂打进一球并助攻另一球。事实上，他可能应该梅开二度，因为他一反常态地在禁区内射门偏出。但让他与众不同的不仅仅是进球贡献。这是他的全能发挥。这是他赢得的 13 场对决中的全场最高数字，这是他在控球时表现出的工作效率，这是他比赛的每一个部分。切尔西手上有一名特殊的前锋，球迷们将会很高兴看到他在未来几年能够达到的水平。

news.title: David Fofana completes permanent move
news.title_zh: 大卫·福法纳完成永久转会
news.body_en: David Fofana has completed a permanent transfer to Swiss Super League side Servette.  The 23-year-old signed for the Blues from Molde in January 2023, scoring 17 goals and providing three assists during his time at Chelsea and on loan. We thank David for his efforts during his time at Chelsea and wish him well as he begins a new chapter in his career.

news.title: PL2 report: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen 5-4 West Ham United U21s
news.title_zh: PL2 报告：切尔西科巴姆下一代 5-4 西汉姆联 U21
news.body_en: An incredible afternoon of drama saw Chelsea Cobham Next Gen come from three goals down to equalise, go behind once more and still manage to come back to secure a memorable 5-4 victory over London rivals West Ham United in the final minutes of the game. West Ham striker Josh Landers will go home knowing he couldn't have done much more to secure victory for the Hammer, as he completed a first-half hat-trick for the visitors to put his side 3-0 up and then grabbed another in the second period. However, Harrison Bettoni's goal in first-half injury-time proved critical for the Blues as we mounted a second-half fightback. Lewi Richards and Sol Gordon both scored superb - albeit very different - goals to bring the Blues level before Landers restored West Ham’s advantage with his fourth goal. But with just two minutes of normal time remaining, Reggie Watson made it two penalties in as many PL2 games when he converted and in the second minute of injury-time, Chizaram Ezenwata lifted the ball over the goalkeeper to complete a memorable comeback. It was Chelsea who applied the early pressure. The first opening fell to Leo Black, whose left-footed drive from distance was blocked, before Ezenwata worked space in the box but his right-footed effort was charged down. But the visitors went ahead after 13 minutes. Ryan Battrum’s header was not collected and Landers reacted to bundle the ball in. Chelsea looked to bounce back initially. Bettoni missed with a close-range header, Olutayo Subuloye saw his follow-up blocked, Sol Gordon saw a header saved, as did Richards with his two efforts. Landers doubled West Ham’s advantage in ten minutes before the break, meeting Junior Robinson’s cross from the right and finding the net from close range. A third followed seven minutes later. Jethro Medine delivered from the left and Landers was left with a simple finish into an empty net to complete his hat-trick. Chelsea grabbed a crucial lifeline in the third minute of first-half stoppage time. Richards curled a cross into the box from the left and Bettoni headed home, continuing his promising start to life as a Blue following his move from Wigan Athletic. The Blues reduced the deficit further in the 53rd minute. Watson’s free-kick was blocked and Bettoni’s follow-up also struck a defender, but Richards collected the loose ball and thumped a superb effort into the net from 25 yards. By this point it was all Chelsea and the pressure kept mounting. Gordon drew us level six minutes later, using two sharp touches and his pace following a ball down the channel to beat Josh Briggs before finishing well from the corner of the six-yard box. Olutayo Subuloye went close to putting us ahead in the 68th minute when he rose highest, but none of his team-mates could provide the required finish at the far post. But somewhat against the run of play, West Ham regained the lead with 10 minutes remaining. Freddy Bernal produced an outstanding point-blank save to deny Battrum, but with no offside flag forthcoming, Landers converted the rebound from close range. Calvin Diakite, introduced for Richards, made an immediate impact as he was brought down inside the penalty area in the 87th minute. Watson stepped forward and smashed the resulting spot-kick into the roof of the net. West Ham would have won it themselves had it not been for Bernal making a superb save with his feet from a header in the first minute of added time. Instead, Chelsea completed the turnaround moments later. A defensive error released Ezenwata, who lifted the ball beyond the advancing goalkeeper with the side of his foot. The victory gives us our first three points of the 2026/27 Premier League 2 campaign following the opening defeat at Bournemouth, moving us into the top half of the table. news.body_zh: 令人难以置信的下午，切尔西科巴姆下一代在落后三球的情况下扳平比分，在再次落后的情况下，仍然在比赛的最后几分钟以 5-4 战胜了伦敦对手西汉姆联队，令人难忘。西汉姆联前锋约什·兰德斯在回家时知道自己已经无法为铁锤帮取得胜利，他在上半场完成了帽子戏法，帮助客队以 3-0 领先，并在下半场再进一球。然而，哈里森·贝托尼在上半场伤停补时阶段的进球对蓝军来说至关重要，我们在下半场发起了反击。刘易斯·理查兹和索尔·戈登都打进了精彩的进球（尽管差异很大），帮助蓝军扳平比分，随后兰德斯用他的第四个进球恢复了西汉姆联队的优势。但在正常比赛时间仅剩两分钟时，雷吉·沃森在 PL2 比赛中罚进了两粒点球，伤停补时第二分钟，奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔 (Chizaram Ezenwata) 将球越过了门将，完成了令人难忘的逆转。切尔西一开始就施加了压力。莱奥·布莱克率先破门，他的左脚远射被挡出，随后埃森瓦塔在禁区内创造了空间，但他的右脚射门被挡了下来。但客队在13分钟后取得领先。瑞恩·巴特鲁姆的头球攻门没有被接住，兰德斯做出反应，将球打入。切尔西一开始似乎希望反弹。贝托尼近距离头球攻门偏出，奥卢塔约·苏布洛耶的跟进被挡出，索尔·戈登的头球被扑出，理查兹的两次射门也被扑出。兰德斯在中场休息前十分钟将西汉姆联队的优势扩大了一倍，接到朱尼尔·罗宾逊的右路传中并近距离射门入网。七分钟后又发生了第三次。杰思罗·梅丁 (Jethro Medine) 左路传球，兰德斯 (Landers) 轻松射门破门，完成帽子戏法。上半场补时第3分钟，切尔西抓住了关键的救命稻草。理查兹从左路将球传入禁区，贝托尼头球破门，继续他从维冈竞技转会到蓝军后的美好开局。第53分钟，蓝军进一步缩小比分差距。沃森的任意球被挡出，贝托尼的跟进也击中了一名后卫，但理查兹接住了球，并在 25 码处将一脚精彩射门入网。至此，一切都变成了切尔西的事情，压力不断增加。六分钟后，戈登利用两次犀利的触球和他的速度将球扳平，然后将球传过通道，击败了乔什·布里格斯，然后从六码禁区角落射门。第 68 分钟，奥卢塔约·苏布洛耶 (Olutayo Subuloye) 的射门几乎让我们领先，但他的队友都无法在远门柱完成所需的射门。但在比赛还剩 10 分钟时，西汉姆联队重新领先。弗雷迪·伯纳尔 (Freddy Bernal) 做出精彩的近距离扑救，挡住了巴特鲁姆 (Battrum) 的防守，但由于没有越位旗标，兰德斯 (Landers) 近距离将球打进。理查兹替补登场的卡尔文·迪亚基特（Calvin Diakite）立即发挥了作用，他在第 87 分钟在禁区内被放倒。沃森挺身而出，将点球踢入网顶。如果不是伯纳尔在补时第一分钟用脚做出精彩的扑救，西汉姆联队自己就能赢得这场比赛。相反，切尔西随后完成了逆转。防守失误释放了埃森瓦塔，他用脚的一侧将球举过前进的守门员。继揭幕战输给伯恩茅斯后，这场胜利让我们获得了 2026/27 赛季英超联赛 2 赛季的首个三分，使我们跻身积分榜上半区。 Cobham Next Gen 将于 9 月 12 日星期六重返 PL2 比赛，届时我们将在 Meadow Park 迎战阿森纳 21 岁以下青年队。开球时间为下午 1 点，您可以在 CFC+ 上观看比赛直播。切尔西：1.弗雷迪·伯纳尔，2.利奥·布莱克，3.奥鲁塔约·苏布洛耶，4.贾斯汀·奥萨吉，5.刘易·理查兹（14.卡尔文·迪亚基特 81），6.雷吉·沃森，7.贾沙伊德·格林伍德（17.易卜拉欣·拉巴吉 67），8.马赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利，9.奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔，10.哈里森·贝托尼 (18. 安德鲁·彭尼 85), 11. 索尔·戈登未使用替补: 13. 托比·贝尔, 12. 丹特·韦特, 15. 阿尔菲·奥斯本, 16. 哈里森·麦克马洪得分手：哈里森·贝托尼 45+3、刘易斯·理查兹 53、索尔·戈登 59、雷吉·沃森 88（点球）、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔 90+2黄牌：哈里森·贝托尼 16、刘易斯·理查兹 74 主教练：哈里·哈德森 西汉姆联：1.芬利·胡珀，2.朱尼尔·罗宾逊（17.康纳·布鲁克斯 45），3。雷根·克莱顿，4.乔什·布里格斯，5.卡勒姆·利科克，6.莱利·哈根，7.瑞安·巴特鲁姆，8.普雷斯顿·费伦，9.乔什·兰德斯，10.杰夫塔·梅丁（18.安德烈·戴克78），11.杰思罗·梅丁未上场替补：13.汤米·古德格，12.刘易斯·贝克福德，14.加布里埃尔卡利斯特，15. 丹尼尔·卡明斯，16. 哈里·蒙塔古得分手：乔什·兰德斯 13, 35, 42, 80黄牌：朱尼尔·罗宾逊 19，里根·克莱顿 47，杰思罗·梅丁 68，康纳·布鲁克斯 69 经理：马克·罗布森

news.title: How challenges of the past continue to shape Emi Martinez's future
news.title_zh: 过去的挑战如何继续塑造埃米·马丁内斯的未来
news.body_en: For much of his career, Emi Martinez has been driven by one ambition: to win. And he has built quite the CV: a FIFA World Cup, two Copa Americas, two FIFA Best Goalkeeper of the Year awards, a UEFA Europa League and an FA Cup. That only scratches the surface, too. There’s no shortage of experience. But behind the trophies and accolades is something much deeper. His relentless desire to win and hunger to keep pushing for more can be traced back to his childhood and the sacrifices his parents made to help him chase his dream. He has never forgotten their efforts. And now, as he joins us at Cobham wearing a Chelsea shirt for the first time, he’s more than ready for his next chapter. ‘I like to think about the past,’ Martinez says. ‘I like to see where I’ve come from. It reminds me of the tireless work from my family and me. That's my style. That's how I approach life. ‘I helped my family come from poverty into the life that we have now. My mum and dad worked 15 hours a day to give me this opportunity, and they helped inspire me. Everything today is for them. ‘Chelsea are one of the best clubs in the world, not just in England.  I'm super excited and I wanted that challenge. ‘I attach my life to football. I live for football. I sleep for football. All I care about is having a good family and winning football matches, and now I get to do that for Chelsea.’ That relentless desire for success is something Martinez, who made his debut in our 4-3 victory over Brighton and Hove Albion, believes makes him and the Blues the perfect match. ‘Chelsea and I have a winning mentality,’ he continues. ‘I think we connect in that sense. It’s all about winning. Win or nothing, and I have won everything as an international and as an individual goalkeeper. ‘I’ve been in England for nearly 17 years and now, for me, it's about winning the Premier League. That’s what is missing in my beautiful career. I have come to a club where winning is a priority. And for me, trophies are such a priority. It’s the perfect match.’ The 33-year-old’s role at Chelsea will extend beyond simply keeping the ball out of the net and winning football matches. Having built a reputation as a goalkeeper whose personality and presence can have a significant influence on those in front of him, he wants everyone around him to feel that same confidence from the moment they step onto the pitch. He explains: ‘I want my team-mates to look back and feel, "Oh, Emi's there". I want them to trust me. I want to give them that peace from the back so they can play free. My role is to help them as much as I can. I want to protect them. ‘When you see the Chelsea squad and the size of the club, it just speaks for itself. We’ve got wonderful talent up front, wonderful players at the club, experienced players. So that mix can really help us move forward as a club.’ Martinez is the second player to have swapped Villa Park for Stamford Bridge this summer. Morgan Rogers joined the Blues earlier in the transfer window and the Argentine is looking forward to reuniting with the England international in the Blues dressing room. ‘It’s great to see the likes of Morgan [Rogers] again,’ Martinez smiles. ‘He's such a brilliant talent that I saw coming through from Middlesbrough to Aston Villa. He’s developed so much in his game. And for me, he's the best English forward alongside Cole (Palmer) – the best two English players.’ Martinez has already enjoyed his first experience of Stamford Bridge and the atmosphere created by the Chelsea faithful. Yet there will be much more to come in the months ahead, and he is looking forward to delivering for the Blues supporters. ‘I'm going to give 100 per cent for Chelsea with pride,’ he says. ‘I’m going to try and win games, keep clean sheets, and get Stamford Bridge rocking. ‘It's a huge club, and I won't be happy with draws or losing, so I think I’ll have a connection with the fans. All I want to do is win games.’
news.body_zh: 在埃米·马丁内斯职业生涯的大部分时间里，他一直被一个野心所驱动：获胜。他已经建立了相当多的简历：一次国际足联世界杯、两次美洲杯、两次国际足联年度最佳门将奖、一次欧洲联赛和一次足总杯。这也只是触及了表面。不乏经验。但奖杯和荣誉的背后还有更深层次的东西。他对胜利的不懈渴望和不断追求更多的渴望可以追溯到他的童年以及他的父母为帮助他追逐梦想而做出的牺牲。他从未忘记他们的努力。现在，当他第一次穿着切尔西球衣来到科巴姆时，他已经为自己的下一个篇章做好了充分的准备。 “我喜欢思考过去，”马丁内斯说。 “我喜欢看看我从哪里来。这让我想起了我和我的家人的不懈努力。这就是我的风格。这就是我对待生活的方式。 “我帮助我的家人摆脱贫困，过上了现在的生活。我的妈妈和爸爸每天工作 15 个小时才给我这个机会，他们帮助激励了我。今天的一切都是为了他们。 “切尔西是世界上最好的俱乐部之一，而不仅仅是英格兰。  我非常兴奋，我想要这个挑战。 “我将我的生命与足球联系在一起。我为足球而活。我睡觉是为了踢足球。我所关心的是拥有一个美好的家庭并赢得足球比赛，现在我可以为切尔西做到这一点。”在我们 4-3 战胜布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩的比赛中首次亮相的马丁内斯相信，对成功的不懈渴望使他和蓝军成为完美的搭档。 “切尔西和我都有一种获胜的心态，”他继续说道。 “我认为我们在这个意义上有联系。一切都是为了胜利。不管赢还是输，作为一名国家队球员和一名个人门将，我已经赢得了一切。 “我在英格兰已经快17年了，现在对我来说，最重要的是赢得英超联赛。这就是我美好的职业生涯所缺少的。我来到了一家以胜利为首要任务的俱乐部。对我来说，奖杯是最重要的。这是一场完美的比赛。”这位 33 岁的球员在切尔西的角色将不仅仅只是将球挡出球门并赢得足球比赛。作为一名门将，他的个性和表现可以对他面前的人产生重大影响，他因此而享有盛誉，他希望周围的每个人从踏上球场的那一刻起就感受到同样的自信。他解释道：“我希望我的队友们回头看时会感觉‘哦，艾米就在那里’。”我希望他们信任我。我想从后面给他们带来平静，这样他们就可以自由地比赛。我的职责是尽我所能帮助他们。我想保护他们。 “当你看到切尔西的阵容和俱乐部的规模时，它本身就说明了一切。我们拥有出色的锋线人才、俱乐部出色的球员、经验丰富的球员。因此，这种组合确实可以帮助我们作为一个俱乐部向前迈进。”马丁内斯是今年夏天第二位从维拉公园队转投斯坦福桥的球员。摩根·罗杰斯在转会窗口早些时候加盟了蓝军，阿根廷人期待着与英格兰国脚在蓝军更衣室重聚。 “很高兴再次见到摩根[罗杰斯]这样的人，”马丁内斯微笑着说。 “他是一位才华横溢的天才，我从米德尔斯堡到阿斯顿维拉都看到了他。他在比赛中进步了很多。对我来说，他是最好的英格兰前锋，与科尔（帕尔默）并肩——最好的两名英格兰球员。”马丁内斯已经很享受他在斯坦福桥的第一次经历以及切尔西球迷营造的氛围。然而，未来几个月还会有更多的事情发生，他期待着为蓝军支持者做出贡献。 “我将自豪地为切尔西付出 100% 的努力，”他说。 “我会努力赢得比赛，保持不失球，让斯坦福桥摇滚起来。 “这是一家巨大的俱乐部，我不会对平局或输球感到高兴，所以我想我会与球迷建立联系。我想做的就是赢得比赛。

news.title: Alonso: 'I’m very happy to feel this energy and support at the Bridge'
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：“我很高兴在桥上感受到这种能量和支持”
news.body_en: As Xabi Alonso took his seat in the Chelsea dugout ahead of our victory over Brighton and Hove Albion, he glanced briefly to the Shed End where a banner had been unfurled in his honour. It read: 'Not too Xabi. Alonso is a Blue' It was a fitting way to mark Alonso's first Premier League home fixture at Stamford Bridge – and the Blues' performance certainly entertained those in the stands. We went ahead inside four minutes when Romeo Lavia prodded home from close range following a corner. Pedro Neto and Joao Pedro then struck to put Alonso's side in a commanding position just after the half-hour mark. Yet Brighton hit back, first through Malick Yalcouye and then via a Joao Pedro own goal. However, after regaining our composure, Cole Palmer expertly guided home a fourth goal to seal the points, despite Pascal Gross scoring late on for the Seagulls. Alonso enjoyed the manner of our victory, although he accepted there are aspects of his side's performance that must be improved. What the Blues manager had universal praise for was the backing from the Chelsea faithful before and during the 90 minutes. ‘It felt great,' he reflected after the Blues' 4-3 victory. 'I’m very happy to come to the Bridge and feel this energy and support. There will be great games, there will be difficult moments, but we need to stick together.’ It was highlighted in Alonso's post-match press conference that the Blues had come away victorious despite having significantly less of the ball than Brighton. When asked if that was by design, the Blues manager reiterated that the demands on his players will adapt to each game. He explained:  ‘You need to have context for the data. For sure, after 30 mins when we scored to make it 3-0, probably in that moment we have played too much with the result [in mind] instead of keeping on playing. 'So, it’s about how we play and what we can do better. I never say we need 60 per cent or 20 per cent possession. It’s about how we prepare and how we can be more competitive. 'You have to adapt, even during games, and there are different moments and there are some moments we’ve done really well and others we can do better.’
news.body_zh: 在我们战胜布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩之前，哈维·阿隆索在切尔西教练席就座，他瞥了一眼谢德恩德，那里已经展开了向他致敬的横幅。上面写着：“不太Xabi。”阿隆索是蓝军的一员 这是阿隆索在斯坦福桥的首场英超主场比赛的恰当方式，而蓝军的表现无疑让看台上的观众感到高兴。四分钟后，罗密欧·拉维亚开出角球后近距离射门，我们取得领先。佩德罗·内托和若昂·佩德罗在半小时后发起进攻，让阿隆索的球队处于领先地位。然而布莱顿进行了反击，首先是通过马利克·亚尔库耶，然后是若昂·佩德罗的乌龙球。然而，在我们恢复冷静后，尽管帕斯卡·格罗斯为海鸥队取得了进球，但科尔·帕尔默熟练地打进了第四个进球，锁定了分数。阿隆索很享受我们的胜利，尽管他也承认球队的表现在某些方面还需要改进。这位蓝军主帅受到普遍赞誉的是切尔西球迷在90分钟前和90分钟期间的支持。 “感觉太棒了，”他在蓝军 4-3 获胜后回忆道。 “我很高兴来到大桥并感受到这种能量和支持。会有精彩的比赛，会有困难的时刻，但我们需要团结在一起。”阿隆索在赛后新闻发布会上强调，尽管控球率明显低于布莱顿，但蓝军还是取得了胜利。当被问及这是否是有意为之时，蓝军主帅重申，对球员的要求将根据每场比赛而调整。他解释说：“你需要了解数据的背景。当然，当我们在 30 分钟后将比分改写为 3-0 时，可能在那一刻我们已经过度关注结果了，而不是继续比赛。 “所以，问题在于我们如何打球以及我们可以做得更好。我从来没有说过我们需要 60% 或 20% 的控球率。这是关于我们如何准备以及如何更具竞争力。 “你必须适应，即使是在比赛中，也有不同的时刻，有些时刻我们做得很好，有些时刻我们可以做得更好。”

news.title: Emi Martinez on taking the Chelsea No.26 shirt: ‘I spoke with John Terry!’
news.title_zh: 埃米·马丁内斯 (Emi Martinez) 谈及切尔西 26 号球衣：“我和约翰·特里谈过了！”
news.body_en: The No.26 shirt made famous at Chelsea by John Terry has a new owner, and Emi Martinez has promised to wear it with pride after joining the Blues from Aston Villa. It was confirmed yesterday (Sunday) morning that Martinez had signed for Chelsea – and he made his debut in our eventful 4-3 victory over Brighton. Martinez made several crucial saves during his first 90 minutes as a Blue, as we made it two wins from two in the Premier League. Ahead of the game at Stamford Bridge, Martinez was announced as our new No.26. He doesn’t take the privilege lightly, with only three other players – and most famously Chelsea legend John Terry – being assigned the squad number in the 21st century. Martinez explained that he had spoken to our former skipper – Terry coached at Aston Villa during the goalkeeper's time in the Midlands – before taking on the famous shirt. He said: ‘I remember using the 26 on loan a few times with previous clubs, and of course I knew John Terry famously had the 26 here. ‘John was someone I spoke to before I joined, and he said he was over the moon to have me here. From our time together at Aston Villa, he knows how hard I work and what I can bring to Chelsea. JT really helped me with my decision. ‘The morning I signed, I texted him and said, "I'm wearing your shirt, and I'm going to do it with pride."'
news.body_zh: 约翰·特里 (John Terry) 在切尔西一举成名的 26 号球衣现在有了新主人，埃米·马丁内斯 (Emi Martinez) 承诺在从阿斯顿维拉加盟蓝军后会自豪地穿着这件球衣。昨天（周日）早上确认马丁内斯已加盟切尔西，他在我们 4-3 战胜布莱顿的比赛中首次亮相。马丁内斯在代表蓝军出战的前90分钟内做出了几次关键扑救，帮助我们在英超联赛中取得了两场胜利。在斯坦福桥比赛之前，马丁内斯被宣布为我们的新 26 号球员。他并没有轻视这一特权，在 21 世纪，只有另外三名球员——其中最著名的是切尔西传奇人物约翰·特里——被分配了球队号码。马丁内斯解释说，在穿上这件著名的球衣之前，他曾与我们的前队长特里（特里在阿斯顿维拉担任门将期间执教）进行过交谈。他说：“我记得在以前的俱乐部中多次租借过 26 号球衣，当然我知道约翰·特里 (John Terry) 在这里拥有 26 号球衣。 “在我加入之前，我曾与约翰交谈过，他说他很高兴能邀请我来到这里。从我们在阿斯顿维拉一起度过的时光起，他就知道我有多努力，也知道我能为切尔西带来什么。 JT 确实帮助我做出了决定。 “我签约的那天早上，我给他发短信说，‘我穿着你的球衣，我会自豪地这么做。’”

news.title: A special day for Chelsea and Joao Pedro!
news.title_zh: 对于切尔西和若昂·佩德罗来说，这是一个特别的日子！
news.body_en: There was a moment at Stamford Bridge where Joao Pedro buried his head in his hands and the Brighton fans behind the goal taunted their former hero. The Brazilian had just dragged an effort wide that you would have put money on him tucking away, especially given the form the forward has been in. But the saying ‘the cream always rises’ couldn’t be more apt, and it wasn’t long before Chelsea's No.9 was celebrating in front of those Seagulls fans situated in the Shed End as he rifled home a low drive into the bottom corner to extend our lead to 3-0. The joy on his face said it all; this goal meant more. However, this is the Premier League, and no game is a given. Our 3-0 advantage – courtesy of goals from Romeo Lavia, Pedro Neto and Joao Pedro – was reduced to 3-1 just before the break. Momentum then shifted. Brighton were pushing and pulled another goal back to make it 3-2, ironically via the boot of Joao Pedro, who diverted a cross his own net. Several fine stops from debutant Emi Martinez kept the visitors at arm’s length before Cole Palmer – who else? – continued his fine form against the Seagulls by putting the game to bed with a stunning strike. So, what did our centre-forward make of all that then? ‘I think we started really well, and we got ourselves into a very commanding position with the three goals,’ Joao Pedro explained. ‘Once we conceded a goal though, it brought Brighton back into the game. ‘I think we should have been more consistent and not allow them to get that energy and belief, because we could have killed the game a lot earlier. ‘But I think the team did really well overall, and Dibu [Emi Martinez] showed his quality with some really good saves. ‘We all tried our best defensively and, step by step, we achieved our level, saw the game out and of course the most important thing was to get the three points, which we did.’ It was another productive afternoon for our new attacking line of Joao Pedro, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers – the former two finding the net and the latter causing Fabian Hurzeler’s side a mountain of problems off the left and creating our second goal. Joao Pedro was sharp, led the line expertly and took his goal well – celebrating in front of the Brighton fans who once adored him – and the forward revealed that part of the tactical approach was to utilise the Brazilian’s pace against his former club. ‘I know them [Brighton] really well, so I knew I could be dangerous on the counter and when we turned over possession,’ he stated. ‘We felt that we could show a little bit of speed up front, and we utilised that well. ‘I think up front we are very strong, and myself, Cole and Morgan are linking up well. To be honest, throughout the whole team we have good depth, we have very good players in each position and now we need to build the confidence, the togetherness and maintain this form. ‘It’s been a good start to the season and hopefully we can keep winning.’
news.body_zh: 在斯坦福桥的那一刻，若昂·佩德罗将头埋在双手中，球门后的布莱顿球迷嘲笑他们的前英雄。巴西人刚刚的一脚射门偏出了球门，尤其是考虑到这位前锋目前的状态，你会为他的射门付出代价。但“奶油总是升起”这句话再贴切不过了，不久之后，切尔西的9号球员就在谢德恩德的海鸥队球迷面前庆祝，他一脚低射入网底角，将我们的领先优势扩大到3-0。他脸上的喜悦说明了一切。这个目标意义重大。然而，这是英超联赛，没有一场比赛是注定的。由于罗密欧·拉维亚、佩德罗·内托和若昂·佩德罗的进球，我们的 3-0 优势在中场休息前被缩小为 3-1。随后势头发生了转变。布莱顿队在反击中又扳回一球，将比分改写为3-2，具有讽刺意味的是，佩德罗的射门将球挡出自家球门。首次亮相的埃​​米·马丁内斯 (Emi Martinez) 的几次精彩停留让客队在科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 面前保持了一定的距离——还有谁呢？ – 在对阵海鸥队的比赛中延续了他的良好状态，以一记惊人的进球结束了比赛。那么，我们的中锋对这一切有何看法呢？ “我认为我们的开局非常好，我们凭借三个进球占据了非常有利的位置，”若昂·佩德罗解释道。 “一旦我们丢了一个球，布莱顿就重新回到了比赛中。 “我认为我们应该更加一致，不让他们获得那种能量和信念，因为我们本可以更早地杀死比赛。 “但我认为球队整体表现非常好，迪布（埃米·马丁内斯）通过一些非常好的扑救展示了他的能力。 “我们都在防守上尽了最大努力，一步一步地达到了我们的水平，见证了比赛的结束，当然最重要的是拿到三分，我们做到了。”对于我们的新进攻线若昂·佩德罗、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯来说，这又是一个富有成效的下午——前两人进球，后者在左路给法比安·胡尔泽勒的球队带来了一大堆问题，并创造了我们的第二个进球。若昂·佩德罗很犀利，熟练地领导球队并出色地进球——在曾经崇拜他的布莱顿球迷面前庆祝——这位前锋透露，战术方法的一部分是利用巴西人的速度来对抗他的前俱乐部。 “我非常了解他们（布莱顿），所以我知道我在反击中以及当我们交出控球权时可能会很危险，”他说。 “我们觉得我们可以在前面表现出一点速度，并且我们很好地利用了这一点。 “我认为我们在锋线上非常强大，我、科尔和摩根配合得很好。老实说，整个球队都有很好的深度，每个位置都有非常优秀的球员，现在我们需要建立信心、团结并保持这种状态。 “这是本赛季的良好开局，希望我们能够继续获胜。”

news.title: Inside the life of Katie McCabe
news.title_zh: 凯蒂·麦凯布的生活内部
news.body_en:
After providing an assist on her competitive Chelsea debut against Real Sociedad, Katie McCabe fills us in on her journey so far and how she likes to spend her time away from the sport. Could you start by telling us where you grew up and what it was like? I grew up in Tallaght in Dublin. And, yeah, it was amazing; proper old school. There were no phones, so just constantly out on the football pitches playing football with the boys and spending time with my siblings. What age did you start playing football? What was the name of your first grassroots team? Kilnamanagh AFC, you'll have to do your research on that one, though! View this post on Instagram            
How old were you when you first joined an academy? There were no academies, just the boys' team when I was six. What's been your career highlight to date? I think probably qualifying for the World Cup with Ireland in 2023. Who are your best friends in football? I'm lucky; I have a lot. But my best friend, I would say, is Grace Moloney. Could you name your top three favourite players of all time? I've got all these legends appearing in my mind! I love Damien Duff. I loved Niamh Fahey - she also played for Chelsea. And Eden Hazard. What do you like to do away from football? How do you switch off? I like to be with my friends, going out and socialising. And I like to spend time with my dog and my cat. Are you watching any TV series currently? I'm currently in the middle of the Rafa Nadal documentary. If we looked at your Spotify playlist, who's dominating your most played artists of the year? Sonny Fodera and Fisher. They're both DJs. What are your top three holiday destinations, either that you’ve been to or want to visit? I love Ibiza, Majorca and I also love going to Australia. If you had guests over for dinner, what would you cook for them? Tell the fans something they might not know about you... I think all the information about me is out there already! Maybe that I have 11 siblings. What's the best piece of advice you've ever received? Don't get too high with the highs, and don't get too low with the lows. Finally, what does football mean to you? Football is a massive part of my life, but it's not my whole life. And I think as I've gotten older, I've realised that a bit more. I think to get the best out of me from a football point of view, I know I need to have balance off the pitch.
news.body_zh:
凯蒂·麦凯布在切尔西对阵皇家社会的比赛中首次亮相并送出助攻后，向我们介绍了她迄今为止的旅程以及她喜欢如何度过远离足球的时光。您能首先告诉我们您在哪里长大以及是什么样的吗？我在都柏林的塔拉特长大。是的，这太棒了；适当的老派。没有电话，所以我只能经常在足球场上和孩子们一起踢足球，并与我的兄弟姐妹共度时光。您几岁开始踢足球？你的第一个草根团队叫什么名字？基尔纳马纳 AFC，不过，你必须对此进行研究！在 Instagram 上查看这篇文章            
您第一次加入学院时几岁？我六岁时，没有学院，只有男孩队。迄今为止，您的职业生涯亮点是什么？我认为可能会与爱尔兰一起获得 2023 年世界杯的参赛资格。谁是你在足球界最好的朋友？我很幸运；我有很多。但我想说的是，我最好的朋友是格蕾丝·莫洛尼。你能说出你最喜欢的三名球员吗？我的脑海里浮现出这些传说！我爱达米恩·达夫。我喜欢 Niamh Fahey——她也曾为切尔西效力。还有伊登·阿扎尔。足球之外你喜欢做什么？你如何关闭？我喜欢和朋友在一起，出去社交。我喜欢和我的狗和猫一起度过时光。您目前正在观看任何电视剧吗？我现在正在观看拉法·纳达尔的纪录片。如果我们查看一下您的 Spotify 播放列表，谁在您年度播放次数最多的艺术家中占据主导地位？桑尼·福德拉和费舍尔。他们都是 DJ。您去过或最想去的三个度假胜地是什么？我喜欢伊维萨岛、马略卡岛，我也喜欢去澳大利亚。如果你有客人来吃饭，你会为他们做什么菜？告诉粉丝一些他们可能不知道的关于你的事情……我想关于我的所有信息都已经在那里了！也许我有11个兄弟姐妹。您收到过的最好的建议是什么？高潮时不要太高，低谷时也不要太低。最后，足球对你来说意味着什么？足球是我生活的重要组成部分，但它不是我生活的全部。我想随着年龄的增长，我对这一点有了更多的认识。我认为从足球的角度来看，我知道我需要在场外保持平衡。

news.title: Alonso on Martinez: 'He has this aura to influence'
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈马丁内斯：“他有这种影响力”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was happy with the impact Emi Martinez made on his Chelsea debut and believes the goalkeeper’s ‘aura to influence’ will help the Blues throughout the season. The Argentine international's arrival from Aston Villa was confirmed this (Sunday) morning. Martinez signed a three-year contract at Stamford Bridge and went straight into our starting XI for Brighton and Hove Albion's visit. Martinez looked instantly at home and produced several impressive reaction stops throughout our 4-3 victory, which came through goals from Romeo Lavia, Pedro Neto, Joao Pedro and Cole Palmer. Alonso was not surprised by the ease with which Martinez settled into the Chelsea side, and only expects the goalkeeper's influence to increase going forward. He said: 'Emi is a World Cup winner, is 33 years old, and is very experienced. I spoke with him yesterday (Saturday) and we talked about the game and our team. He felt ready, and I don’t have to tell him many things for him to perform. 'Even today, while a goalkeeper wants to keep a clean sheet, I am happy with his impact. He has been in the building just 48 hours, so now we will have a whole week to prepare for the next one. ‘Day by day, we will feel this presence because he has this charisma, this aura to influence and have a very positive connection with the rest of the team.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索对埃米·马丁内斯在切尔西首秀中所产生的影响感到高兴，并相信门将的“影响力”将在整个赛季帮助蓝军。这位阿根廷国脚从阿斯顿维拉抵达的消息已于今天（周日）上午得到确认。马丁内斯在斯坦福桥签下了一份为期三年的合同，并在布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩的比赛中直接进入我们的首发阵容。马丁内斯在我们以 4-3 获胜的过程中立即表现出在家的感觉，并通过罗密欧·拉维亚、佩德罗·内托、若昂·佩德罗和科尔·帕尔默的进球，做出了几次令人印象深刻的反应扑救。阿隆索对马丁内斯轻松融入切尔西队并不感到惊讶，只希望这位门将的影响力在未来会不断增强。他说：“Emi是世界杯冠军，今年33岁，经验丰富。我昨天（周六）和他谈过，我们谈论了比赛和我们的球队。他觉得自己已经准备好了，我不需要告诉他很多事情就可以让他表演。 “即使在今天，虽然门将希望保持不失球，但我对他的影响感到满意。他在大楼里只待了 48 小时，所以现在我们将有一整周的时间为下一场比赛做准备。 “日复一日，我们会感受到这种存在，因为他有这种魅力、这种影响力的光环，并与团队其他成员有着非常积极的联系。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on overcoming Brighton and Moises Caicedo injury
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索克服布莱顿和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的伤病
news.body_en: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso emphasised the ‘value’ of this afternoon's 4-3 victory over Brighton and Hove Albion – and provided an update on Moises Caicedo after the midfielder was forced off with an injury in the second half. For 32 minutes of the contest at Stamford Bridge, the Blues were in full control. We opened the scoring early, with Romeo Lavia converting from close range for his first Chelsea goal, before Pedro Neto and Joao Pedro then found the net. Brighton reacted, though. They reduced the deficit before the interval through Malick Yalcouye and pulled another goal back when Joao Pedro turned a cross into the Blues’ net. However, Alonso’s players displayed their resilience to respond and re-establish our advantage, as Cole Palmer curled an excellent shot home from 20 yards. That proved enough to secure all three points, despite a late consolation from Pascal Gross. Alonso once again highlighted that there are improvements for his side to make in the weeks ahead, but he was pleased the Blues had overcome a difficult opponent to make it two wins from two Premier League fixtures at the start of the campaign. ‘All the wins I enjoy a lot, but it was a game that in different moments had different feelings,' Alonso explained in his post-match press conference. 'In the end, we’re happy with the result. We value this win against a very good opponent who have been tough in the last few years. We are happy with that, and there are things and moments that we have done well, but it’s a process to keep on learning and improving. Usually, that is easier with a win.’ The one negative of the afternoon was Caicedo's injury. The Ecuadorian midfielder missed our opening two fixtures of the season but was introduced from the substitutes' bench midway through the second period. However, 13 minutes after coming on, Caicedo was forced off and replaced by Valentin Barco, who helped the Blues get over the line. 'He was cautious to stop and say his feeling wasn’t the best,' Alonso replied when asked about the midfielder's injury after the game. 'We need to assess during the week, but it wasn’t something new.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西主教练哈维·阿隆索强调了今天下午 4-3 战胜布莱顿和霍夫·阿尔比恩的比赛的“价值”，并在莫伊塞斯·凯塞多下半场因伤被迫下场后提供了他的最新情况。在斯坦福桥的32分钟比赛中，蓝军完全掌控了比赛。我们很早就率先破门，罗密欧·拉维亚近距离射门打入他在切尔西的第一个进球，随后佩德罗·内托和若昂·佩德罗进球。不过布莱顿做出了反应。中场休息前，他们通过马利克·亚尔库耶缩小了比分差距，并在若奥·佩德罗将传中送入蓝军球网时扳回一球。然而，阿隆索的球员展现了他们的韧性，做出了回应并重新确立了我们的优势，科尔·帕尔默在 20 码外打出了一记精彩的射门。事实证明，这足以确保全取三分，尽管帕斯卡·格罗斯在最后时刻给予了安慰。阿隆索再次强调，他的球队在未来几周内还有待改进，但他很高兴蓝军在赛季初的两场英超比赛中战胜了一个难缠的对手，取得了两场胜利。 “我很享受所有的胜利，但这是一场在不同时刻有不同感觉的比赛，”阿隆索在赛后新闻发布会上解释道。 “最后，我们对结果感到满意。我们很重视这场对阵过去几年表现强劲的优秀对手的胜利。我们对此感到高兴，有些事情和时刻我们做得很好，但这是一个不断学习和改进的过程。通常，获胜会更容易。”下午的一个负面因素是凯塞多的受伤。厄瓜多尔中场缺席了我们本赛季的前两场比赛，但在第二节中途从替补席上被换上场。然而，上场13分钟后，凯塞多被迫下场，被瓦伦丁·巴尔科换下，后者帮助蓝军越过防线。 “他谨慎地停下来并说他的感觉​​不是最好的，”赛后被问及这位中场球员的伤势时阿隆索回答道。 “我们需要在本周内进行评估，但这并不是什么新鲜事。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 4-3 Brighton
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 4-3 布莱顿
news.body_en: Romeo Lavia, Pedro Neto, Joao Pedro and Cole Palmer were all on target as the Blues made it three wins from three games with an entertaining 4-3 victory over Brighton and Hove Albion. We were once again free-flowing in attack and opened up a three-goal advantage after just 32 minutes. Lavia netted his first Chelsea goal to break the deadlock after four minutes, and both Neto and Joao Pedro found the net with clinical finishes from inside the penalty area. Brighton reduced the deficit before interval via Malick Yalcouye, and grabbed a second just after the hour-mark when Joao Pedro deflected a cross into our net. Yet Alonso's side, as they did against Fulham, showed the right response to pressure and, with 16 minutes to play, Palmer swept home a 20-yard strike. The Seagulls did grab a late third – Pascal Gross heading home – but it proved nothing more than a late consolation. Alonso made seven changes to the side that started our Carabao Cup second-round victory over Luton Town on Thursday Emi Martinez, whose signing was confirmed earlier in the day, started in goal. Wesley Fofana, Maxence Lacroix and Levi Colwill were the back three, with Neto and Jorrel Hato at wing-back. Lavia was partnered in midfield by Malo Gusto, and the front three was Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Joao Pedro. Before the action got underway, there were touching tributes to two influential Chelsea figures who passed away this summer: our second all-time highest goalscorer, Bobby Tambling, and our former chairman, Ken Bates. Both will be missed. At Fulham on Monday night, the Blues made a rapid start and were ahead inside 35 seconds. Our opener didn't arrive quite as early against the Seagulls, but just four minutes were on the clock. Neto was heavily involved, as the Portugal international won and delivered a corner that Joao Pedro met at the near post. Mats Wieffer got back onto the line to block, but a mix-up with goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen saw the ball fall to Lavia, who nudged a shot over the line for his first Chelsea goal. The Blues were firmly on top. We moved the ball confidently across the pitch and carried a threat whenever we advanced into Brighton's defensive third. And ten minutes after going ahead, we fashioned our second goal of the contest. Rogers was the creator, collecting a Joao Pedro knock-down and forcing his way past Mario Vuskovic. The England international squared the ball into the penalty area, and Neto burst forward to finish beyond Verbruggen. We should have had a third midway through the half, as Neto chased down and brushed aside Ferdi Kadıoglu and played a pass to Joao Pedro. The Brazilian took a touch, which sat down two Brighton defenders, but he guided his finish from 12 yards wide. Martinez, aside from coming to collect a couple of crosses, had little work to do in the opening half-hour. He did have to produce a smart reaction stop, though, when Yalcouye prodded a cross toward goal. Joao Pedro – booed throughout by the supporters of his former club – briefly silenced the away end with a deserved 32nd-minute goal. Hato was instrumental, exchanging passes in our half with Rogers and surging upfield with the ball. Wieffer was unable to keep up with the Dutchman, who fed the ball to Joao Pedro and the Blues' No.9 made no mistake with his finish. Unfortunately, our three-goal advantage was quickly reduced as Brighton pulled a goal back through Yalcouye, who rifled a volley in off the post after Martinez had denied Diego Gomez. Before the interval, each side created one further chance: Rogers came close for the Blues with a shot from distance that flashed past the post, while Gomez headed wide. The second period remained an open affair – perhaps too much for Alonso's liking. Brighton made better use of the space and caused the Blues problems. Many of the Seagulls' chances fell to Gomez. The Paraguayan forward dragged a shot wide before missing a close-range header from a free-kick. It was a chance he should have scored. Our threat remained and Neto did excellently once again to shrug off Kadıoglu and break into the box. His near-post effort was saved and, on the rebound, Rogers whipped a cross into the six-yard box for Palmer, who could only volley over. Martinez's first big save in a Chelsea shirt came soon after, as he reacted excellently to push wide a shot from Gomez. Unfortunately, from the resulting corner, the ball was worked to Pascal Gross, whose pass deflected off Joao Pedro and ended in our net. Alonso soon turned to his bench. Josh Acheampong, Reece James and Moises Caicedo, playing his first minutes of the season, were introduced. The booked Fofana, Lavia and Neto were replaced. Our changes didn't immediately quell the Brighton tide, and Martinez had to save well from a powerful drive from Olivier Boscagli. It was an important moment as, five minutes later, the Blues struck our fourth goal of the game. The goal had shades of our first, as Joao Pedro controlled and laid off a throw-in. This time, Palmer collected the ball, advanced 20 yards, and then curled a shot expertly beyond Verbruggen. Sixteen minutes remained – and the Blues worked hard to see out the contest. We shifted into a 5-4-1 shape, which largely kept Brighton outside our box, and enabled Joao Pedro to lead several counter-attacks, which were often stopped illegally by Brighton defenders. There were five minutes of stoppage time and it appeared there would be no more goals added to the scoreline. However, in the final action of the game, a long Brighton throw was flicked on and headed home by Gross. It proved too late to alter the destination of the points, with Alonso's side taking six from our opening two top-flight fixtures. We travel across London next weekend to face Arsenal at the Emirates Stadium on Sunday 6 September. Kick-off is scheduled for 4.30pm (UK time). Chelsea: Martinez; Fofana (Acheampong 68), Lacroix, Colwill (c) (Chavarria 72); Neto (Caicedo 68, Barco 82), Gusto, Lavia (James 68), Hato; Palmer, Rogers; Joao Pedro.Chelsea substitutes: Penders, Caicedo, Gittens, Estevao Willian, Welbeck.Goalscorers: Lavia 4, Neto 14, Joao Pedro 32Booked: Fofana 55 Brighton: Verbruggen, Wieffer (Costinha 80), Vuskovic, Dunk, Kadioglu; Gross, Boscagli; Gomez, Yalcouye (Osman 74), De Cuyper; Kostoulas Brighton substitutes: Steele, Struijk, Hadjam, Cozier-Duberry, O'Riley, OriolaGoalscorers: Yalcouye 35, Joao Pedro og 62, Gross 90+6Booked: Dunk 70, Boscagli 89, Costinha 90+1
news.body_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚、佩德罗·内托、若奥·佩德罗和科尔·帕尔默均命中目标，蓝军以 4-3 的比分击败布莱顿和霍夫·阿尔比恩，取得三场比赛三胜。我们的进攻再次流畅，仅仅32分钟后就取得了三球优势。四分钟后，拉维亚攻入他在切尔西的首个进球，打破僵局，内托和若昂·佩德罗在禁区内冷静射门破门。布莱顿在中场休息前通过马利克·亚尔库耶缩小了比分差距，并在比赛结束一小时后，若昂·佩德罗将传中球挡入我们的球网，从而取得了第二个进球。然而阿隆索的球队，就像对阵富勒姆的比赛一样，对压力做出了正确的反应，比赛还剩 16 分钟时，帕尔默一记 20 码射门横扫破门。海鸥队确实获得了第三名——帕斯卡·格罗斯(Pascal Gross)回家——但这只不过是最后的安慰。阿隆索对球队做出了七项调整，在周四卡拉宝杯第二轮战胜卢顿镇的比赛中，埃米·马丁内斯首发出场，他的签约在当天早些时候得到了确认。韦斯利·福法纳、马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦和利维·科尔威尔是三后卫，内托和乔雷尔·哈托担任边后卫。拉维亚中场搭档马洛·古斯托，前场三人分别是帕尔默、摩根·罗杰斯和若昂·佩德罗。在活动开始之前，人们对今年夏天去世的两位有影响力的切尔西人物表示了感人的悼念：我们的历史第二射手鲍比·坦布林和我们的前主席肯·贝茨。两者都会被怀念。周一晚上对阵富勒姆的比赛中，蓝军开局迅速，在 35 秒内就取得了领先。我们的揭幕战并没有像对阵海鸥队那样早到来，但比赛只剩下四分钟了。内托积极参与，这位葡萄牙国脚获胜并开出角球，若昂·佩德罗在近门柱接应。马茨·维弗回到球门线上进行拦截，但由于与门将巴特·维尔布鲁根的失误，球落到了拉维亚手中，拉维亚将球推过球门线，打进了他在切尔西的第一个进球。蓝军稳居榜首。我们自信地把球传过球场，每当我们进入布莱顿的防守三区时，我们都会产生威胁。比赛开始十分钟后，我们制定了比赛的第二个目标。罗杰斯是创造者，他接住了若昂·佩德罗的击倒，并强行超越了马里奥·武斯科维奇。英格兰国脚将球传入禁区，内托突破维尔布鲁根射门。我们应该在半场中段取得第三球，内托追赶并推开费迪·卡德奥格鲁并将球传给若昂·佩德罗。巴西人触球，导致两名布莱顿后卫被撞倒，但他在 12 码外完成射门。马丁内斯除了来收集几个传中球外，在开场半小时内几乎没有什么事情可做。不过，当亚尔库耶将传中球射向球门时，他确实必须做出明智的反应停止。若昂·佩德罗（Joao Pedro）在整个过程中都受到了他的前俱乐部支持者的嘘声，他在第 32 分钟的进球短暂地让客队陷入了沉默。哈托发挥了重要作用，他在我们半场与罗杰斯交换传球，并带球冲向前场。维弗无法跟上荷兰人，后者将球传给若奥·佩德罗，蓝军9号的射门没有失误。不幸的是，我们的三球优势很快就被缩小了，布莱顿通过亚尔库耶扳回一球，在马丁内斯挡出迭戈·戈麦斯后，亚尔库耶抽射破门。中场休息前，双方都创造了一次机会：罗杰斯为蓝军差点射门，但戈麦斯头球攻门偏出。第二节仍然是一场公开赛——也许阿隆索不喜欢。布莱顿更好地利用了空间，给蓝军带来了麻烦。海鸥队的很多机会都落到了戈麦斯身上。巴拉圭前锋一脚射门偏出，但随后任意球近距离头球攻门偏出。这是他应该进球的机会。我们的威胁依然存在，内托再次出色地摆脱了卡德奥格鲁并闯入禁区。他的近门柱射门被扑出，在篮板球上，罗杰斯将球传入六码禁区，帕尔默只能凌空抽射。马丁内斯身披切尔西球衣后不久就完成了第一次重大扑救，他反应出色，将戈麦斯的射门推偏。不幸的是，球从开出的角球传给了帕斯卡·格罗斯，他的传球偏离了若昂·佩德罗的方向，最终落入我们的球门。 阿隆索很快转向他的替补席。乔什·阿奇姆蓬 (Josh Acheampong)、里斯·詹姆斯 (Reece James) 和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 (Moises Caicedo) 出场，他们在本赛季的第一分钟上场。黄牌出战的福法纳、拉维亚和内托被换下。我们的改变并没有立即平息布莱顿的浪潮，马丁内斯不得不从奥利维尔·博斯卡利的强力射门中扑救出来。这是一个重要的时刻，五分钟后，蓝军打进了我们本场比赛的第四个进球。这个进球与我们的第一个进球有些相似，若昂·佩德罗控制住了球，并掷出了界外球。这一次，帕尔默接球，推进20码，然后熟练地一脚弧线球越过维尔布鲁根。比赛还剩十六分钟，蓝军努力拼搏以结束比赛。我们转变为5-4-1阵型，这在很大程度上将布莱顿挡在了我们的禁区之外，并使若昂·佩德罗能够领导几次反击，但这些反击经常被布莱顿后卫非法阻止。补时还有五分钟，比分上似乎不会再有进球了。然而，在比赛的最后时刻，布莱顿的长传被格罗斯弹出，头球破门。事实证明，改变积分的归属为时已晚，阿隆索的球队在我们的前两场顶级联赛中拿下了六分。下周末我们将穿越伦敦，于 9 月 6 日星期日在酋长球场迎战阿森纳。开球时间定于下午 4.30（英国时间）。切尔西：马丁内斯；福法纳（Acheampong 68）、拉克鲁瓦、科尔威尔（c）（查瓦里亚 72）；内托（凯塞多 68，巴科 82）、古斯托、拉维亚（詹姆斯 68）、哈托；帕默，罗杰斯；若昂·佩德罗。切尔西替补：彭德斯、凯塞多、吉滕斯、埃斯特沃·威廉、维尔贝克。进球者：拉维亚 4、内托 14、若昂·佩德罗 32 黄牌：福法纳 55 布莱顿：维尔布鲁根、维弗（科斯蒂尼亚 80）、武斯科维奇、邓克、卡迪奥格鲁；格罗斯，博斯卡利；戈麦斯、亚尔库耶（奥斯曼 74）、德库珀；科斯托拉斯·布莱顿替补：斯蒂尔、斯特鲁伊克、哈贾姆、科齐尔-杜伯里、奥莱利、奥里奥拉进球球员：亚尔库耶 35、若奥·佩德罗 62、格罗斯 90+6 黄牌：邓克 70、博斯卡利 89、科斯蒂尼亚 90+1

news.title: Xabi Alonso on why Martinez starts
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索谈马丁内斯首发的原因
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has spoken of his delight at recruiting Emi Martinez and revealed why he has decided to hand the Argentina international a debut today. The goalkeeper completed his switch from Aston Villa earlier today and starts between the sticks as we face Brighton at Stamford Bridge today. Alonso explained the reasoning behind that decision when speaking pre-match earlier today. ‘We are very happy with Emi and we are delighted to have him here at Chelsea,’ Alonso said of Martinez ahead of his Blues debut. ‘To have such a goalkeeper of this stature, of this personality, it’s very good for us. ‘I think that he will bring lots of qualities, and I'm sure that he can have a straight impact, and that's why we decided that he’s ready to play straightaway.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈到了他对招募埃米·马丁内斯的高兴，并透露了为什么他决定今天让这位阿根廷国脚首次亮相。这名门将今天早些时候完成了从阿斯顿维拉的转会，并在今天我们在斯坦福桥对阵布莱顿的比赛中首发出场。阿隆索在今天早些时候的赛前讲话中解释了这一决定背后的原因。 “我们对埃米感到非常高兴，我们很高兴他来到切尔西，”阿隆索在马丁内斯的蓝军首秀之前说道。 “拥有这样一位身材、性格的门将，对我们来说非常好。 “我认为他会带来很多品质，我相信他能够产生直接影响，这就是为什么我们决定他已经准备好立即上场。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Brighton
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵布莱顿的阵容
news.body_en: Emi Martinez makes his Chelsea debut as one of seven changes made to the Blues side by Xabi Alonso for this afternoon's Premier League clash against Brighton and Hove Albion. After starting our top-flight campaign with a victory at Fulham, and then defeating Luton Town in the Carabao Cup, the Blues are looking to make it three wins from three under Alonso, who was appointed manager earlier this summer. Martinez's signing from Aston Villa was confirmed this morning, and the Argentine goalkeeper goes straight into the starting XI to make his debut in front of the Stamford Bridge faithful. The 33-year-old will be protected by a back three consisting of Wesley Fofana, Maxence Lacroix and Levi Colwill – who skippers Chelsea today against his former loan club – with Pedro Neto and Jorrel Hato expected as the right and left wing-backs. Romeo Lavia looks set to be partnered by Malo Gusto in midfield, while Alonso has reverted to the attack that started against Fulham on Monday night. Each of Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Joao Pedro scored in the game and will hope to do the same against the Seagulls. Danny Welbeck, who netted against Luton on Thursday night, starts on the bench against his former club, as do former Albion duo Moises Caicedo and Valentin Barco. Chelsea: Martinez; Fofana, Lacroix, Colwill (c); Neto, Gusto, Lavia, Hato; Palmer, Rogers; Joao Pedro. Chelsea substitutes: Penders, James, Acheampong, Chavarria, Caicedo, Barco, Gittens, Estevao Willian, Welbeck.

news.title: Emiliano Martinez signs for Chelsea!
news.title_zh: 埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯加盟切尔西！
news.body_en: Chelsea is delighted to announce the signing of Argentinian international Emiliano Martínez from Aston Villa. The 33-year-old goalkeeper, who won the World Cup in 2022, has signed a three-year deal with the Blues. 'I’m delighted to be at this football club,' Martinez said. 'Coming to Chelsea, for me and my family, was an easy decision to make and I’m just over the moon - I can’t wait to get started. 'I want to be successful here. I'm someone who wants to win at everything I do and I want to bring that here to this football club because it’s a football club that wins titles, so I think it’s a good match. 'I’m all passion and I play with my heart. I will give 100 per cent every game, every training session to make the club, my teammates and the supporters proud.' Having started his career in the youth system of Independiente, Martinez completed a move to Arsenal in August 2010, aged 17. After several loans to gain first-team experience, he became a regular for Arsenal in the 2019/20 campaign, starting the last 11 matches and winning the FA Cup. He won the Community Shield at the start of the following season before signing for Aston Villa in September 2020. During his time in the Midlands, Martinez established himself as one of the world’s leading goalkeepers. He made 256 appearances for Villa across six seasons and lifted the UEFA Europa League in May. Martinez made his international debut in June 2021 and has since been Argentina’s first-choice goalkeeper, earning 67 caps for his country. He has twice won the Copa America (2021 and 2024) with La Albiceleste and lifted the World Cup in 2022. Following those successes, Martinez received the Yashin Trophy, awarded to the world’s best-performing goalkeeper, at the 2023 and 2024 Ballon d’Or ceremonies.
news.body_zh: 切尔西很高兴宣布从阿斯顿维拉签下阿根廷国脚埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯。这位在2022年赢得世界杯的33岁门将与蓝军签订了一份为期三年的合同。 “我很高兴来到这个足球俱乐部，”马丁内斯说。 “对于我和我的家人来说，来到切尔西是一个很容易做出的决定，我欣喜若狂——我迫不及待地想开始。 “我想在这里取得成功。我是一个凡事都想赢得胜利的人，我想把它带到这个足球俱乐部，因为这是一个赢得冠军的足球俱乐部，所以我认为这是一场很好的比赛。 “我充满激情，用心打球。我会在每场比赛、每一次训练中付出百分百的努力，让俱乐部、我的队友和球迷感到自豪。”马丁内斯的职业生涯始于独立青训系统，2010年8月，年仅17岁的马丁内斯转会至阿森纳。在多次租借获得一线队经验后，他在2019/20赛季成为阿森纳的主力，在过去11场比赛中首发并赢得了足总杯冠军。他在下个赛季开始时赢得了社区盾杯，然后于 2020 年 9 月签约阿斯顿维拉。在中部地区效力期间，马丁内斯确立了自己作为世界领先门将之一的地位。他在六个赛季中为维拉出场 256 次，并于 5 月份夺得了欧洲联赛冠军。马丁内斯于 2021 年 6 月完成国家队首秀，此后成为阿根廷队的首选门将，为国家队出场 67 次。他随阿尔比塞莱斯特队两次赢得美洲杯冠军（2021 年和 2024 年），并在 2022 年捧起世界杯冠军。继这些成功之后，马丁内斯在 2023 年和 2024 年金球奖颁奖典礼上获得了亚辛奖杯，该奖杯是颁发给世界上表现最佳的门将。

news.title: Watch Emi Martinez's first interview as a Chelsea player
news.title_zh: 观看埃米·马丁内斯作为切尔西球员的首次采访
news.body_en: England has been home to Emi Martinez for almost 17 years. Yet while the country has shaped him as a person and a player, it is the values instilled while growing up in the Argentine city of Mar del Plata that have underpinned his career. Martinez officially began his journey in the English game – and eventually to becoming a Chelsea player – in August 2010. He had developed a reputation as one of South America's most promising goalkeepers while in the Independiente youth system and earned a move to Arsenal. Far away from home, Martinez had to adapt quickly. Within a year, he had learned English and passed his driving test. Yet on the pitch, it took far longer for the goalkeeper to make his mark. There were several loans in the Football League, and a brief spell in La Liga with Getafe, but as the 2019/20 campaign reached its conclusion, Martinez got a run in the Arsenal first team and never looked back. He lifted the FA Cup and the Community Shield before joining Aston Villa. During Martinez's time in the Midlands, he established himself as Argentina's first-choice goalkeeper and lifted two Copa Americas and a FIFA World Cup. In each of those triumphs, Martinez's drive and determination have shone through. And that mentality was formed in his childhood, as he explained in his first interview since becoming a Blue, which you can watch in full for free above. 'Becoming a footballer was always to help my family, to get them a better life and take them out of poverty,' Martinez explained. 'That drive is still in my football career. It doesn’t matter what I’ve won or where I’ve reached, I want more. 'I want them to be proud of me. Now I’ve got kids, I want them to see nothing comes easy in life. So I am still competing and I want more.’ Martinez has joined the Blues after six seasons at Villa Park, during which he twice received the Yashin Trophy, awarded to the world's best-performing goalkeeper. Now 33 years old, Martinez has no intention of settling on his former glories. He knows the expectations that come with being a Chelsea player and wants to match them throughout his time at Stamford Bridge. ‘I give 100 per cent every game and, when you see me play every day or in training sessions, I give you my all,' he says. 'I try to win every game; it doesn’t matter who we play against. I am bringing that here to this club because it’s a winning club that wins titles and wins things.'
news.body_zh: 埃米·马丁内斯 (Emi Martinez) 已在英格兰生活了近 17 年。然而，尽管这个国家塑造了他作为一个人和一名球员，但支撑他职业生涯的却是在阿根廷城市马德普拉塔成长过程中灌输的价值观。马丁内斯于 2010 年 8 月正式开始了他的英格兰足球之旅，并最终成为切尔西球员。在独立青年队期间，他被誉为南美洲最有前途的门将之一，并获得转会到阿森纳的机会。远离家乡，马丁内斯必须迅速适应。一年之内，他学会了英语并通过了驾驶考试。然而在球场上，守门员花了更长的时间才留下自己的印记。他曾多次被租借到足球联赛，并在西甲赫塔菲短暂效力过一段时间，但随着2019/20赛季的结束，马丁内斯在阿森纳一线队中获得了一席之地，并且再也没有回头。在加盟阿斯顿维拉之前，他举起了足总杯和社区盾杯。马丁内斯在中部地区效力期间，确立了自己作为阿根廷队的首选门将的地位，并捧起了两届美洲杯冠军和一座世界杯冠军奖杯。在每一次胜利中，马丁内斯的动力和决心都得到了体现。这种心态是在他的童年时期形成的，正如他在成为蓝队后的第一次采访中所解释的那样，您可以在上面免费观看完整内容。 “成为一名足球运动员总是为了帮助我的家人，让他们过上更好的生活，让他们摆脱贫困，”马丁内斯解释道。 “这种动力仍然存在于我的足球生涯中。无论我赢得了什么或达到了什么程度，我都想要更多。 “我希望他们为我感到骄傲。现在我有了孩子，我希望他们看到生活中没有什么是容易的。所以我仍在参加比赛，而且我想要更多。”马丁内斯在维拉公园效力了六个赛季后加入了蓝军，在此期间他两次获得了雅辛奖杯，该奖杯被授予世界上表现最好的门将。现年 33 岁的马丁内斯无意安于昔日的辉煌。他知道作为一名切尔西球员所带来的期望，并希望在斯坦福桥期间能够满足这些期望。 “我每场比赛都会付出百分百的努力，当你看到我每天比赛或训练时，我都会全力以赴，”他说。 “我努力赢得每一场比赛；我们和谁比赛并不重要。我把它带到这个俱乐部，因为这是一个赢得冠军和赢得东西的胜利俱乐部。”

news.title: Alonso: Now is the time to deliver
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：现在是交付的时候了
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso wants to repay the Chelsea supporters for their warm welcome with victory in an early test of our Premier League credentials on home soil against Brighton & Hove Albion. Our new manager has already experienced the support of the home crowd at Stamford Bridge on two occasions, when we beat Real Sociedad in our final friendly of pre-season and then defeated Luton Town to book our place in the Carabao Cup third round on Thursday evening. For the first home Premier League fixture of Alonso’s reign, Brighton are the visitors to west London in a 2pm kick-off on Sunday afternoon, with the Spaniard expecting another good reception for him and his team from the Blues fans. ‘It’s nice,’ responded Alonso. ‘We are happy to have that support and myself to have this welcome from the fans. ‘I have felt since the first day I was here that they were happy that we were starting this time together. Now is the time to deliver and the time to show it every weekend. ‘We’ve had two games and it’s a good start, but it’s still early days. On Sunday, we have a good game, a good test, to see where we are. ‘We will have bumps in the road, for sure, and we need to prepare for that. How we react, how we stick together, how we keep the mentality will be important. ‘So it’s early days and there have been good things, but there are things to develop and progress as well.’ Alonso has faced Brighton’s manager before, during his time at Bayer Leverkusen, leaving the Spaniard expecting a tough but important test of Chelsea’s early season progress from Fabian Hurzeler’s Seagulls side. ‘I know him very well from Germany, from St Pauli,’ added Alonso. ‘He is developing the team with new players. ‘They are a very intense team that do interesting things. So that’s why it’s going to be a good clash and a good test on Sunday.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索希望在主场对阵布莱顿的英超联赛资格早期测试中取得胜利，以回报切尔西球迷的热烈欢迎。我们的新主教练已经在斯坦福桥两次感受到了主场球迷的支持，当时我们在季前赛最后一场友谊赛中击败了皇家社会，然后在周四晚上击败了卢顿镇，获得了卡拉宝杯第三轮的席位。阿隆索执教期间的首场英超主场比赛将在周日下午 2 点在伦敦西部客场对阵布莱顿，西班牙人期待蓝军球迷再次为他和他的球队带来良好的接待。 “这很好，”阿隆索回答道。 “我们很高兴能得到球迷的支持，我本人也很高兴受到球迷的欢迎。 “从我来到这里的第一天起，我就感觉到他们很高兴我们这次能一起开始。现在是交付的时间，也是每个周末展示的时间。 “我们已经踢了两场比赛，这是一个良好的开端，但现在还为时过早。周日，我们有一场精彩的比赛，一场精彩的测试，看看我们现在的位置。 “我们的道路肯定会遇到坎坷，我们需要为此做好准备。我们如何反应、如何团结一致、如何保持心态都很重要。 “所以现在还处于早期阶段，有一些好的事情，但也有一些事情需要发展和进步。”阿隆索之前在勒沃库森效力期间曾面对过布莱顿的主教练，这让西班牙人期待着来自法比安·胡尔策勒的海鸥队对切尔西赛季初期进展的艰难但重要的考验。 “我来自德国、来自圣保利，非常了解他，”阿隆索补充道。 “他正在用新球员来发展球队。 “他们是一支非常热情的团队，做着有趣的事情。这就是为什么周日这将是一场精彩的冲突和一场精彩的考验。”

news.title: Chelsea vs Brighton: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 布莱顿：您需要知道的一切
news.body_en: Bank Holiday weekend used to mean Londoners piling onto trains bound for the seaside, but this weekend Brighton & Hove Albion come to Chelsea. Club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton look ahead to a 2pm kick-off at Stamford Bridge with Premier League points on the line. Like Fulham away on Monday, this was a fixture the world champions lost last time around after having a player sent off. The 10 men in royal blue led 1-0 but were eventually downed 3-1 with Danny Welbeck, now under Xabi Alonso’s direction, among the visitors’ stoppage-time scorers. In fact the Blues have not beaten the Seagulls since Cole Palmer’s 10-minute hat-trick inspired a 4-2 victory at the Bridge in September 2024. On Thursday the visitors completed the job against Tromso to qualify for the UEFA Conference League proper, only their second European campaign. Last time they had to fulfil European midweeks, in 2023/24, they slipped from the previous sixth-place Premier League finish to 11th. Also on Thursday, Chelsea’s first home game of the season ended in a 2-0 victory over Luton Town, with Welbeck opening his Blues account. The Londoners can now secure three consecutive wins on all fronts for the first time since January (a run of five). Xabi Alonso is hopeful Chelsea midfielder Moises Caicedo will be ready to face Brighton on Sunday, and confirmed Levi Colwill and Geovany Quenda are in contention to face the Seagulls after missing the win over Luton. 'There were no issues [with Colwill and Quenda], and the plan is that they are training and preparing for the game on Sunday,' said Alonso in his pre-match press conference on Thursday night. 'He [Caicedo] is hopefully training and we are hopeful that he can be involved, but we need to check. No decision has been made.’ One player expected to be in contention to return for the Blues on Sunday is Wesley Fofana, who served the second of his two-match suspension against Luton. Summer signing Jordan Henderson may need more time, with Alonso stating that the Blues are waiting for him to be given the 'green light to play soon' following the injury he sustained during the World Cup. Chelsea have won just one of our past seven first home league games of the campaign, a 3-0 victory over Crystal Palace in 2021 with goals from Marcos Alonso, Christian Pulisic and debutant Trevoh Chalobah's first for the club. The remainder of that run comprises four draws and three losses, but it was not always such hard going at the Bridge. The Blues have won 20 of our previous 34 opening home games in the Premier League era, drawing 10 and losing four. The first of those victories came against Norwich City in 1994, as Glenn Hoddle’s project entered its second season. With the Shed End removed for redevelopment, goals from Frank Sinclair and Paul Furlong either side of the break settled the score. In 1999, a stellar set of goal scorers saw off a decent Sunderland side 4-0 – Gus Poyet (two), Gianfranco Zola and Tore Andre Flo – and a year later Mario Stanic made his mark with a stunning volley during a 4-2 romp against West Ham United. Then, in 2004, the game was forgettable but the result was vital, as Jose Mourinho’s management began with a 1-0 win against title rivals Manchester United thanks to Eidur Gudjohnsen. Three years later, United’s ’noisy neighbours’ Man City were taken apart by goals from iconic trio John Terry, Frank Lampard and Didier Drogba, while in 2010, 1997 FA Cup hero Roberto Di Matteo was shown no mercy as the Blues hit his West Bromwich Albion team for six – a club record for a curtain-raiser at the Bridge. A fine record of opening-day success heralding a title win was upheld in 2016, as Antonio Conte savoured a 2-1 derby defeat of West Ham, ahead of what proved another glorious campaign. Chelsea (1.96) and Brighton (3.54) recorded the highest expected goals tallies over the opening weekend of the Premier League. The Seagulls have scored three goals in each of their past three Premier League encounters with the Blues. Welbeck scored three of those. Following our 3-2 victory at Fulham, Chelsea have won six of the past seven opening away fixtures of the Premier League season. Thanks to Monday’s west London derby win, the world champions are already three points up on last season’s corresponding Premier League fixtures. Victory over Brighton would make that six. Chelsea’s run of 17 league outings without a clean sheet is the longest for the club since the same number in 1991, which ended with the Blues winning 1-0 at Sheffield United on 3 September – straight after a 4-1 home win against Luton Town. Thursday’s 2-0 Carabao Cup victory over Luton was our first shutout in any competition since the 1-0 win in last season’s FA Cup semi-final grudge-match with Leeds United, who will now be our next opponents in the League Cup. Apart from opening his goals account at the first attempt, Morgan Rogers set up five chances for team-mates at Fulham, the most by a Chelsea debutant since the statistic was first recorded in 2003/04. Joao Pedro’s 31-second opener at Fulham was the fastest ever over the first weekend of the Premier League season and quickest by a Chelsea player since the other Pedro’s strike against Man Utd in October 2016. 19 seconds - 8 October 1994 - John Spencer vs Leicester City (h)24 seconds - 12 September 1998 - Gianfranco Zola vs Nottingham Forest (h)28 seconds - 3 October 1999 - Gustavo Poyet vs Manchester United (h)29 seconds - 21 February 2004 - Eidur Gudjohnsen vs Arsenal (h)30 seconds - 23 October 2016 - Pedro vs Manchester United (h)31 seconds - 24 August 2026 - Joao Pedro vs Fulham (a)
news.body_zh: 银行假日周末过去意味着伦敦人涌上前往海边的火车，但这个周末布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩来到了切尔西。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿展望下午 2 点在斯坦福桥举行的开赛，英超联赛积分岌岌可危。就像周一客场客场挑战富勒姆一样，这是世界冠军队上次在一名球员被罚下场后输掉的一场比赛。 10 名身着宝蓝色的球员以 1-0 领先，但最终以 3-1 击败丹尼·维尔贝克 (Danny Welbeck)，后者现在在哈比·阿隆索 (Xabi Alonso) 的指挥下，成为客队补时阶段的进球者之一。事实上，自 2024 年 9 月科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 的 10 分钟帽子戏法帮助蓝军以 4-2 的比分战胜海鸥队以来，蓝军还没有击败过海鸥队。周四，客队在对阵特罗姆瑟的比赛中完成了晋级欧足联会议联赛的任务，这是他们第二次参加欧战。上一次他们必须完成欧洲周中比赛是在2023/24赛季，他们从之前的英超联赛第六名滑落至第十一名。同样在周四，切尔西本赛季首个主场比赛以2-0战胜卢顿镇结束，维尔贝克开启了他的蓝军账户。伦敦人自一月份以来首次在各条战线上取得三连胜（五连胜）。哈维·阿隆索希望切尔西中场球员莫伊塞斯·凯塞多能够做好周日对阵布莱顿的准备，并确认列维·科尔威尔和乔瓦尼·昆达在错过了战胜卢顿的比赛后将有机会对阵海鸥队。阿隆索在周四晚上的赛前新闻发布会上表示，“[科尔威尔和昆达]没有出现任何问题，他们计划在周日进行训练和准备比赛。” “他（凯塞多）有望参加训练，我们希望他能够参与其中，但我们需要检查一下。目前尚未做出任何决定。”韦斯利·福法纳（Wesley Fofana）预计将在周日重返蓝军，他在对阵卢顿的两场比赛中停赛第二场。夏季签约的乔丹·亨德森可能需要更多时间，阿隆索表示，在他在世界杯期间受伤后，蓝军正在等待他“尽快上场”。切尔西在本赛季过去七场主场联赛中只赢了一场，2021 年以马科斯·阿隆索、克里斯蒂安·普利西奇和特雷沃·查洛巴的进球以 3-0 战胜水晶宫，这是俱乐部的首场比赛。剩下的比赛包括四平三负，但在桥上的比赛并不总是那么艰难。蓝军在英超时代之前的34场首场主场比赛中赢了20场，10平4负。第一场胜利是 1994 年对阵诺维奇城的比赛，当时格伦·霍德尔的项目进入了第二个赛季。随着谢德恩德球场被拆除进行重建，弗兰克·辛克莱尔和保罗·弗隆在中场休息时双方的进球决定了比分。 1999 年，一群出色的射手以 4-0 的比分击败了桑德兰队——格斯·波耶特（两名）、吉安弗兰科·佐拉和托雷·安德烈·弗洛——一年后，马里奥·斯塔尼奇在 4-2 战胜西汉姆联队的比赛中以一记令人惊叹的凌空抽射留下了自己的印记。然后，在 2004 年，这场比赛被遗忘，但结果至关重要，何塞·穆里尼奥的管理层在埃杜尔·古德约翰森的帮助下以 1-0 战胜了争冠对手曼联。三年后，曼联的“吵闹邻居”曼城被标志性三人组约翰·特里、弗兰克·兰帕德和迪迪埃·德罗巴的进球分开，而在 2010 年，1997 年足总杯英雄罗伯托·迪马特奥毫不留情，蓝军以六粒进球击败了西布罗姆维奇队，这也是俱乐部在蓝桥揭幕战的纪录。 2016 年，安东尼奥·孔蒂 (Antonio Conte) 在德比战中以 2-1 击败西汉姆联 (West Ham) 的比赛中，保持了开门日成功预示着夺冠的良好记录，随后又迎来了另一个辉煌的赛季。切尔西（1.96）和布莱顿（3.54）创下了英超联赛首周末的最高预期进球数。海鸥队在过去三场英超联赛中与蓝军交锋，每次都打进三个进球。维尔贝克打进了其中的三球。继3-2战胜富勒姆后，切尔西在英超赛季过去七场客场比赛中赢了六场。由于周一西伦敦德比的胜利，世界冠军已经比上赛季相应的英超联赛领先三分。战胜布莱顿将使这一数字达到六分。 切尔西连续 17 场联赛不失球是俱乐部自 1991 年以来最长的一次，最终蓝军在主场 4-1 战胜卢顿镇后于 9 月 3 日以 1-0 战胜谢菲尔德联队。周四卡拉宝杯2-0击败卢顿的比赛是自上赛季足总杯半决赛1-0战胜利兹联以来我们在任何比赛中首次被淘汰，利兹联现在将是我们联赛杯的下一个对手。除了第一次尝试就打开了自己的进球账户外，摩根·罗杰斯还在富勒姆为队友创造了五次机会，这是自2003/04赛季首次记录该统计数据以来切尔西首次亮相的最多机会。若昂·佩德罗在富勒姆的31秒首开纪录是英超赛季第一个周末最快的，也是自2016年10月另一名佩德罗对阵曼联的进球以来切尔西球员最快的。 19秒 -
