news.title: Tributes to Bobby Tambling and Ken Bates at Brighton match
news.title_zh: 向布莱顿比赛中的鲍比·坦布林和肯·贝茨致敬
news.body_en: We wish to inform supporters that there will be pre-match tributes paid to Bobby Tambling and Ken Bates ahead of Sunday afternoon's meeting with Brighton and Hove Albion at Stamford Bridge. We sadly lost our former striker and former chairman during the summer. Members of both families will be present at the game. Fans who wish to take part in the tributes are recommended to be at your seats 15 minutes before the 2pm kick-off.
news.body_zh: 我们希望通知支持者，周日下午在斯坦福桥与布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩的比赛之前，将向博比·坦布林和肯·贝茨表示赛前致敬。我们在夏天不幸失去了前前锋和前主席。两个家庭的成员都将出席比赛。建议希望参加悼念活动的球迷在下午 2 点开球前 15 分钟到座。

news.title: Danny Welbeck: Brighton reunion will be special
news.title_zh: 丹尼·维尔贝克：布莱顿重聚将很特别
news.body_en: After a long and storied career in the Premier League, Danny Welbeck is well-versed when it comes to facing former clubs, but Sunday’s meeting with Brighton & Hove Albion will still hold extra significance for the Chelsea striker. There is a familiar feel to Sunday’s fixture for Welbeck. A career spent representing several Premier League clubs means the experienced forward has often found himself lining up against former team-mates. That will be the case once more when Chelsea face Brighton this weekend. Yet familiarity will not diminish the significance of the occasion. Brighton remain an important part of Welbeck’s story, making Sunday a fixture he is eagerly anticipating. ‘It’s a special one because Brighton are my former team,’ Welbeck said. ‘Fortunately for me, I’ve played against my old teams quite a lot during my career, so it isn’t anything too new. ‘I’m really looking forward to it and I’m excited to keep pushing on.’ The game will provide another opportunity for Welbeck to build on a smooth start to life at Chelsea. Moving to a new club inevitably brings a period of adjustment, with different surroundings, team-mates and working methods to become accustomed to. However, the forward has felt at home from the moment he arrived at Cobham. He has been grateful for the warmth shown by his new team-mates, the staff and the Chelsea supporters, while the presence of several familiar faces helped make his transition even easier. Throw in a debut goal against Luton Town on Thursday night and it's fair to say Welbeck is enjoying life as a blue. ‘I’ve really enjoyed it and it has been pretty easy for me to settle,’ he explained. ‘It’s such a great group and the staff are very welcoming in and around the training ground. ‘Everybody has been great with me and I’ve been received really well by the fans, so I really appreciate that. ‘It was also nice to know a few familiar faces when I walked through the door, which helped me settle. Now I just want to keep building and improving every single day.’ Welbeck is also enjoying the early stages of working under new manager Xabi Alonso. The Blues are still adapting to Alonso’s methods, with new tactical information being introduced and players returning to the group at different stages following the World Cup and injuries. Welbeck believes patience and hard work will be required as those ideas take shape, but he has been encouraged by the opening weeks and is excited about what lies ahead. ‘It’s been really good and it has been a positive start, but we’re only a couple of games in,’ he added. ‘We have to keep working hard and keep learning the new ideas he is bringing to us. ‘There are a lot of new messages, while some players came back a little later and new players are being integrated and having to settle. But it has been really good up until now and there are really exciting times ahead.’
news.body_zh: 在英超联赛中度过了漫长而传奇的职业生涯后，丹尼·维尔贝克在面对前俱乐部时非常熟练，但周日与布莱顿的比赛对这位切尔西前锋来说仍然具有额外的意义。维尔贝克周日的比赛给人一种熟悉的感觉。这位经验丰富的前锋曾代表多家英超俱乐部度过职业生涯，这意味着他经常发现自己与前队友竞争。当切尔西本周末对阵布莱顿时，情况将再次出现。然而，熟悉度并不会削弱这一场合的重要性。布莱顿仍然是维尔贝克故事的重要组成部分，这使得周日成为他热切期待的一场比赛。 “这是一次特别的比赛，因为布莱顿是我以前的球队，”维尔贝克说。 “对我来说幸运的是，在我的职业生涯中，我经常与我的老球队交手，所以这并不是什么新鲜事。 “我真的很期待它，我很高兴能继续前进。”这场比赛将为维尔贝克提供另一个机会，让他在切尔西的生活顺利开始。转会到新的俱乐部不可避免地会带来一段适应期，需要适应不同的环境、队友和工作方式。然而，从抵达科巴姆的那一刻起，这位前锋就有了宾至如归的感觉。他非常感谢新队友、工作人员和切尔西球迷所表现出的热情，而几位熟悉面孔的出现也让他的过渡变得更加容易。周四晚上对阵卢顿镇的比赛中打进首秀进球，可以公平地说，维尔贝克正在享受蓝军的生活。 “我真的很喜欢它，而且对我来说很容易安定下来，”他解释道。 “这是一个非常棒的团队，训练场内外的工作人员都非常热情。 “每个人都对我很好，我受到了球迷的热烈欢迎，所以我真的很感激。 “当我走进门时，认识一些熟悉的面孔也很高兴，这帮助我安定下来。现在我只想每天继续进步。”维尔贝克也很享受在新教练哈维·阿隆索手下工作的早期阶段。蓝军仍在适应阿隆索的方法，引入了新的战术信息，球员在世界杯和伤病后的不同阶段重返球队。维尔贝克认为，随着这些想法的形成，需要耐心和努力，但他对开始的几周感到鼓舞，并对未来的事情感到兴奋。 “这真的很好，这是一个积极的开始，但我们只进行了几场比赛，”他补充道。 “我们必须继续努力，不断学习他给我们带来的新想法。 “有很多新消息，有些球员回来得晚一些，新球员正在融入并必须安顿下来。但到目前为止，一切都非常好，未来的日子真的很激动人心。”

news.title: Alonso: Acheampong is getting better and better
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：阿奇姆蓬越来越好
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso highlighted the recent development of young defender Josh Acheampong, who has started the 2026/27 season in impressive form. The Chelsea Academy graduate was part of the senior squad last season, but has come into his own under Alonso’s guidance, playing every minute of competitive action for our Spanish manager so far. After helping us to make a winning start to the Premier League campaign against Fulham last weekend and book our place in the Carabao Cup third round with a clean-sheet win over Luton Town in midweek, Alonso explained why he has been impressed by the 20-year-old. ‘With Josh, in pre-season we saw that he has been getting better and better,’ said the Chelsea manager, ahead of Sunday’s meeting with Brighton & Hove Albion. ‘For me, when he plays with confidence and aggressiveness, he has a lot of attributes for a modern defender because he can play in different positions, he’s good with the ball, and he understands his role. ‘I’ve seen a progression in these few weeks we have been together and he has played very solid games against Fulham and Luton. We are happy that he is feeling this way and we need to help him. ‘There will be different moments in the season for sure, because we want to have healthy competition in all positions. But Josh is doing well and we’re happy for him, and he is happy as well.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索强调了年轻后卫乔什·阿奇姆蓬 (Josh Acheampong) 最近的发展，他在 2026/27 赛季开始时的状态令人印象深刻。这位切尔西青训学院的毕业生上赛季曾是成年队的一员，但在阿隆索的指导下已经进入了自己的状态，到目前为止，他为我们的西班牙主教练踢了每一分钟的比赛。上周末帮助我们在英超联赛对阵富勒姆的比赛中取得胜利，并在周中零封击败卢顿镇，确保我们进入卡拉宝杯第三轮后，阿隆索解释了为什么他对这位 20 岁的球员印象深刻。 “在季前赛中，我们看到约什的表现越来越好，”切尔西主帅在周日与布莱顿的比赛之前说道。 “对我来说，当他充满自信和侵略性时，他就具备了现代后卫的很多特质，因为他可以踢不同的位置，他控球能力很好，而且他了解自己的角色。 “在我们在一起的这几周里，我看到了进步，他在对阵富勒姆和卢顿的比赛中表现非常出色。我们很高兴他有这种感觉，我们需要帮助他。 “这个赛季肯定会有不同的时刻，因为我们希望在所有位置上都有良性的竞争。但乔什做得很好，我们为他感到高兴，他也很高兴。”

news.title: Cole Palmer on playing free alongside Morgan Rogers
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默谈与摩根·罗杰斯一起自由打球
news.body_en: Cole Palmer has revealed the conversations he had over the summer with Xabi Alonso and Morgan Rogers that helped him feel ready to produce his best on the pitch at Chelsea this season. Our No10 found it difficult to match the brilliant form of his previous two campaigns with the Blues last season, when his efforts were hindered by injury. However, joined in the line-up by old friend and new team-mate Rogers, under the guidance of manager Alonso, he has made a strong start to the 2026/27 Premier League. That was seen when he provided the assist for Joao Pedro to give us the lead just 31 seconds into our league opener, Rogers also getting on the score sheet before Palmer netted the winner himself, in a 3-2 victory over Fulham. ‘I just felt joy, really, and a bit of disbelief, because I didn't think we were going to score that quick,’ admitted Palmer. That win at Craven Cottage was the first glimpse of former Manchester City academy team-mates Palmer and Rogers in competitive action together for Chelsea, combining to provide the creative spark. ‘I think we're two different players,’ Cole added, when asked about that combination with Morgan. ‘He's more physical, more powerful and stuff, and I'm more technical and whatnot. ‘I just told him [when he joined] that he'll make a big difference. We're signing other players as well, so we're going to have a good team and we can do something good.’ As well as new team-mates, Palmer is playing under a new manager, following Alonso’s arrival in the dugout over the summer, and shared the main message he received from the Spaniard. ‘He just said to be free, because he knows what I can do when I feel good and I feel like I can go wherever on the pitch and find areas where I can cause damage. That's what he's told me.’ All of that leaves Palmer confident he can be back at his very best in 2026/27, although he revealed it is the mental impact of playing free of injury which he believes will make the biggest difference. ‘There were many things last season. Mainly just injury, though. It's just like, because you've been injured and then you're going out thinking, “oh, can I do certain things?”, kind of overthinking things. ‘It’s like, you're not doing things that you used to be able to do because previously it would hurt if you did it and whatnot. But I'm over that now.’ The evidence of that is clear on the pitch, after Palmer helped us open the new season with a league win over Fulham before booking our place in the Carabao Cup third round by beating Luton Town on Thursday evening. Next up, Palmer and Rogers will be hoping to combine to great effect again in our first home Premier League game of 2026/27, when we host Brighton & Hove Albion at Stamford Bridge on Sunday.
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默透露了他今年夏天与哈维·阿隆索和摩根·罗杰斯的对话，这些对话帮助他做好了本赛季在切尔西球场上发挥最佳表现的准备。我们的10号球员发现很难与上赛季他在蓝军前两场比赛中的出色表现相媲美，当时他的努力受到了伤病的阻碍。不过，在老友新队友罗杰斯的加盟下，在主帅阿隆索的带领下，他在2026/27赛季的英超联赛中取得了强势开局。联赛揭幕战开场仅 31 秒，他就为若昂·佩德罗送出助攻，让我们取得领先，罗杰斯也取得进球，随后帕尔默攻入制胜球，帮助球队 3-2 战胜富勒姆。 “我只是感到高兴，真的，还有点难以置信，因为我认为我们不会这么快得分，”帕尔默承认。这场在克雷文小屋的胜利是前曼城青训队友帕尔默和罗杰斯第一次为切尔西在竞技比赛中展现出创造力的火花。当被问及与摩根的组合时，科尔补充道：“我认为我们是两个不同的球员。” “他的身体素质更强，力量更大等等，而我的技术更强等等。 “我只是告诉他（当他加入时）他会带来很大的改变。我们还将签下其他球员，所以我们将拥有一支优秀的球队，我们可以做一些好事。”除了新队友之外，帕尔默在阿隆索夏天来到教练席后，也在新教练的带领下踢球，并分享了他从西班牙人那里收到的主要信息。 “他只是说要自由，因为他知道当我感觉良好时我能做什么，我觉得我可以去球场上的任何地方，找到我可以造成伤害的区域。这就是他告诉我的。”所有这些都让帕尔默相信他可以在 2026/27 赛季恢复到最佳状态，尽管他透露，无伤比赛对精神上的影响，他认为这将带来最大的改变。 “上赛季发生了很多事情。不过主要只是受伤。就像，因为你受伤了，然后你出去想，“哦，我可以做某些事情吗？”，有点想太多了。 ‘这就像，你不再做以前能做的事情，因为以前如果你这样做就会受伤等等。但我现在已经克服了这一点。”在帕尔默帮助我们在联赛中战胜富勒姆开启新赛季之后，周四晚上击败卢顿镇，我们获得了卡拉宝杯第三轮的席位，这在球场上得到了明显的体现。接下来，帕尔默和罗杰斯希望在我们 2026/27 年首场英超主场比赛中再次联手，发挥出色的效果，届时我们将在斯坦福桥迎战布莱顿。

news.title: Chelsea legends remembered in matchday programme

news.body_en: A special matchday programme for our first home Premier League fixture pays tribute to Ken Bates and Bobby Tambling. There is a full obituary to our former chairman, Bates, who ensured that Stamford Bridge remained our home and went on to hold the position for 22 years, in which time we returned to winning major silverware and playing regular European football. As the tribute affirms: 'Football club chairmen became prominent and well-known like never before in the latter part of the 20th Century and none more so than Ken Bates. He was a fighter and proud to be known as one, and the victories he achieved helped shape the Chelsea we know today.' Meanwhile, goal-scoring legend Tambling is remembered in a touching tribute by his former room-mate and strike partner Barry Bridges, who recalls decades of friendship. Referring to his mate as 'an absolute gem', he reflects on their joint dream debut against West Ham United in February 1959. 'Making your debut for Chelsea is one thing, but to go through it all with such a good friend just made it even more special. And for both of us to score was like a dream. You just couldn’t script it. 'The next morning we went to the newsagents and bought a copy of every paper.' Elsewhere in the programme, we introduce new signing Marco Palestra with an exclusive interview, as the reigning Serie A Defender of the Year looks ahead to life at Chelsea. 'I know there is a lot of intensity here... and I like the intensity,' he says. 'I know also there is maybe more physicality, but I feel good about that too. 'I’m sure that I will feel good in the Premier League, I can’t wait to start playing. I feel confident because of my team-mates, and the kind of football there is in the Premier League – I think I can do good here. We will see, but I’m sure that it will be good.' There’s plenty more inside, along with your regular columns and all the info you need on the match itself. Pick up your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge or order online from our publications partner, Reach Sport.
news.body_zh: 我们为首个主场英超联赛制定了特别的比赛日计划，向肯·贝茨和鲍比·坦布林致敬。我们的前主席贝茨有一份完整的讣告，他确保斯坦福桥仍然是我们的主场，并继续担任这个职位 22 年，在此期间我们重新赢得了重要的奖杯并定期参加欧洲足球比赛。正如悼词所肯定的那样：“20 世纪下半叶，足球俱乐部主席变得前所未有的杰出和知名，其中尤以肯·贝茨 (Ken Bates) 为甚。”他是一名斗士，并为自己被称为斗士而感到自豪，他所取得的胜利帮助塑造了我们今天所知道的切尔西。”与此同时，进球传奇人物坦布林的前室友兼前锋搭档巴里·布里奇斯在感人至深的悼念中缅怀了他，并回忆了数十年的友谊。他将他的伴侣称为“绝对的宝石”，并回顾了 1959 年 2 月对阵西汉姆联队的共同梦想首秀。对于我们俩来说，进球就像是一个梦想。你只是无法编写脚本。 “第二天早上，我们去了报刊亭，买了每份报纸。”在节目的其他部分，我们通过独家采访介绍了新签约的马科·帕莱斯特拉，这位卫冕意甲年度最佳后卫展望了切尔西的生活。 “我知道这里有很多强度......而且我喜欢这种强度，”他说。 “我也知道可能会有更多的身体接触，但我对此也感觉很好。 “我确信我在英超联赛中感觉很好，我迫不及待地想开始比赛。我因为我的队友和英超联赛的足球风格而感到自信——我认为我可以在这里做得很好。我们会看到的，但我相信这会很好。”里面还有更多内容，以及您的常规专栏以及您需要的有关比赛本身的所有信息。从斯坦福桥周围的节目销售商处获取您的副本，或从我们的出版物合作伙伴 Reach Sport 在线订购。

news.title: Under-18s report: Chelsea 6-1 Reading
news.title_zh: 18 岁以下队报告：切尔西 6-1 雷丁
news.body_en: An Andrew Pennie hat-trick helped Chelsea Under-18s make it three wins in a row with an emphatic 6-1 victory over Reading at Cobham. Chelsea produced some slick passing on a wet day in Surrey and wasted no time racing into an early lead through Isaac McGillvary and Heze Grimwade's goals. Pennie and Jacob Dako got in on the fun and, although Reading pulled a goal back, the game was all but over as a contest by the half-time break. Not letting our foot off the gas as the rain fell harder in the second half, Pennie found the net twice more to complete his hat-trick and ensure he would take the match ball home, while all three points would be staying in Cobham with the Blues. Reading had lost all four of their games so far this season and that lack of confidence showed in some early loose passes by the away side, and they soon realised why Cobham is such an unforgiving place to visit in that kind of form. Riley Ebho and Grimwade carried plenty of threat down the right straight from the off, but it was from the other flank our early opener arrived. By that time, in the eighth minute, Trey Faromo-Adebayo had already had one goal ruled out for offside. This time there was no flag to Reading’s rescue. Faromo-Adebayo’s strong run down the left created the opportunity when he found McGillvary towards that corner of the box, and our No10 made no mistake with a powerful strike to give Chelsea the lead. It had been coming and there was little surprise when we added a second soon afterwards. McGillvary was denied a second by the goalkeeper, but Grimwade reacted well to turn an awkwardly looping rebound into the empty net on the volley, for his third goal already this season. Chelsea kept pushing despite our two-goal lead, Jacob Hall doing well to step in to win possession high up the pitch and feed Faromo-Adebayo on the left, but he couldn’t find the target with a low drive. It was a sign of the Blues’ relentless attacking approach, which the Royals had little answer to. Although things quietened down for a bit, just after the half-hour mark we had another. Pennie got his first as he held a defender at arm’s length and smashed a shot into the top corner, but Grimwade gets plenty of credit too for his defence-splitting pass to find the striker in space. As the half-time break approached, Chelsea were increasingly dominant of possession, and a long team move of one and two-touch passes stretched our advantage further. The patient build-up accelerated in an instant when Grimwade flicked the ball into the path of Dako, who carried it across the edge of the box before skimming his shot across the wet pitch to nestle into the bottom corner. With the last kick of the first half, Reading pulled one back, as Jeremiah Berkeley-Agyepong scored from a tight angle just days after leaving Chelsea to join the Royals, but it already felt like too little too late for the visitors. This year's long, hot summer felt very much over as the rain really began to lash down at Cobham in the second half, but it didn’t stop Chelsea’s ruthless pursuit of more goals. The keeper had to produce two good saves to deny Pennie and Dako inside the first minute after the restart. Grimwade struck the base of the left-hand post with a curling free-kick and Calvin Diakite couldn’t get enough power on his header with a good opportunity, but with 15 minutes remaining Pennie showed his penalty box instincts twice to claim the match ball. A quick give-and-go between Pennie and Grimwade on the edge of the Reading box allowed the former to spin into the space behind the back line and calmly roll his finish past the keeper. When Reading stood off substitute Ibrahim Rabbaj, allowing him to lift a pinpoint cross to the back post, Pennie eluded his marker to complete his hat-trick and a 6-1 victory with a simple header. With back-to-back wins in the Under-18 Premier League, Chelsea move up to fourth place, three points behind leaders Tottenham Hotspur at this early stage of the season. Chelsea Under-18s will be back in league action next Saturday 5 September, when we travel to neighbours Fulham for an 11am kick-off, which CFC+ subscribers will be able to watch live on the Chelsea Official App and website. (Reading)，取得三连胜。切尔西在萨里的潮湿天气中传出了一些流畅的传球，并且不失时机地通过艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里和赫泽·格里姆韦德的进球早早取得领先。彭尼和雅各布·达科也乐在其中，尽管雷丁扳回一球，但到了中场休息时，比赛几乎就结束了。下半场雨下得更大了，我们没有松懈，彭尼又两次进球，完成了他的帽子戏法，确保他将比赛用球带回家，而所有三分都将留在蓝军的科巴姆。雷丁本赛季到目前为止已经输掉了全部四场比赛，客队早期的一些松散传球表现出了缺乏信心，他们很快意识到为什么科巴姆在这种状态下是一个如此无情的地方。莱利·埃博和格里姆韦德从一开始就在右路带来了很大的威胁，但我们的首场比赛是从另一侧开始的。到了第8分钟，特雷·法罗莫-阿德巴约的一粒进球因越位被判无效。这次没有旗帜来拯救雷丁。法罗莫-阿德巴约在左路的强力跑动创造了机会，他在禁区角落找到了麦吉尔瓦里，我们的 10 号球员没有犯任何错误，一记强力的射门帮助切尔西取得了领先。它已经到来了，当我们不久之后添加第二个时，这并不令人惊讶。麦吉尔瓦里的第二个进球被门将挡出，但格里姆韦德反应出色，将一个笨拙的弧线篮板凌空抽射入空门，这是他本赛季的第三个进球。尽管我们领先两球，切尔西仍在继续推进，雅各布·霍尔在前场表现出色，赢得了控球权，并为左路的法罗莫-阿德巴约喂球，但他的低射未能找到目标。这是蓝军无情进攻的标志，而皇家队对此几乎没有回应。尽管事情平静了一点，但半小时后我们又迎来了另一个。彭尼（Pennie）在与防守队员保持一定距离的距离并将射门打入球门上角时获得了他的第一个进球，但格里姆韦德（Grimwade）也因其突破防线的传球找到了空档中的前锋而获得了很多赞誉。随着中场休息的临近，切尔西在控球权方面的优势越来越明显，一脚和两脚传球的长距离团队移动进一步扩大了我们的优势。当格里姆韦德将球弹到达科的路径上时，耐心的积累瞬间加速，达科将球带过禁区边缘，然后将射门掠过潮湿的球场，落入底角。上半场最后一脚，雷丁队扳回一球，杰里米亚·伯克利-阿吉蓬在离开切尔西加盟皇家队几天后从一个小角度进球，但对于客队来说，这已经太晚了。今年漫长而炎热的夏天感觉已经结束了，下半场科巴姆开始下起大雨，但这并没有阻止切尔西对更多进球的无情追求。比赛重新开始后的第一分钟内，守门员必须做出两次精彩的扑救才挡住了彭尼和达科的射门。格里姆韦德一记弧线任意球击中左侧门柱底部，卡尔文·迪亚基特在一次很好的机会中头球攻门，但在比赛还剩 15 分钟时，彭尼两次展现了他的禁区本能，赢得了比赛用球。在雷丁禁区边缘，佩尼和格里姆韦德之间的快速传球让前者旋转到后防线后面的空间，并冷静地将射门越过了门将。当雷丁队顶住替补球员易卜拉欣·拉巴伊（Ibrahim Rabbaj），让他将一脚精准传中传至后门柱时，佩尼（Pennie）避开了盯防者，完成了帽子戏法，并用一个简单的头球以 6-1 获胜。切尔西在 18 岁以下英超联赛中连续获胜，排名升至第四，在赛季初期落后领头羊托特纳姆热刺 3 分。切尔西 18 岁以下青年队将于下周六 9 月 5 日重返联赛，届时我们将前往邻居富勒姆参加上午 11 点的开球，CFC+ 订阅者将能够在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上观看直播。 切尔西（4-2-3-1）：托比·贝尔； Riley Ebho (Gabriel Sambou 69)、Dante Waite (c)、Jacob news.body_en: Chelsea are at home in the Premier League for the first time in 2026/27 on Sunday, with Brighton & Hove Albion the visitors to west London, and we have all the facts and figures you need ahead of kick-off. Chelsea’s most recent win over the Seagulls came at Stamford Bridge in September 2024, when Cole Palmer scored a 10-minute first-half hat-trick — and four goals in total — to inspire a 4-2 victory.	  In the corresponding fixture at Stamford Bridge last September, two stoppage-time goals by Danny Welbeck and Maxim De Cuyper secured a 3-1 win for Brighton after Enzo Fernandez opened the scoring in the first half. Trevoh Chalobah was sent off after 53 minutes for denying an obvious goal scoring opportunity when we were winning 1-0.Chelsea are looking to prevent Brighton winning four consecutive Premier League games and five in all competitions against us for the first time.The Seagulls have scored three goals in each of their last three Premier League matches against Chelsea. Our summer signing Welbeck scored three of them. Xabi Alonso is the first Chelsea manager since Antonio Conte in 2016 to win his opening two competitive matches. Morgan Rogers against Fulham and Danny Welbeck against Luton became the 92nd and 93rd players to score on their Chelsea debut, and the first since Axel Disasi against Liverpool in August 2023. Chelsea have won 20 of our previous 34 opening home games of a Premier League season, drawing 10 and losing four. The Blues have won our first home league game of the season once in the past seven campaigns (four draws, two defeats), beating Crystal Palace 3-0 in 2021/22. Chelsea (120.1km) and Fulham (121.1km) covered more ground than any other Premier League teams on matchweek one. Chelsea have conceded in each of our last 17 Premier League matches, our longest league run without a clean sheet since a 17-game sequence in the old First Division, between March and August 1991. We last went longer without a league clean sheet in August 1961 (31 games).  Our last Premier League clean sheet was against Brentford at Stamford Bridge on 17 January. Joao Pedro has more goals and assists (13) than any other Premier League forward since the start of 2026. Cole Palmer won possession more times than any other player on the opening weekend of the Premier League season (seven). Palmer and Rogers created four chances for one another against Fulham, the most of any duo in the opening round of Premier League matches. If selected, Welbeck will become the first player ever to make a Premier League appearance for each of Arsenal, Chelsea and Manchester United. Welbeck leads the scoring in Premier League meetings between Chelsea and Brighton with six goals, one ahead of Palmer. Palmer needs two goals to reach 50 league goals for Chelsea. He will become the 28th player to reach the milestone for the club and the ninth in the Premier League era. In beating Aston Villa on Sunday, Brighton were the fastest team ever to go 4-0 up in a Premier League opener, reaching that score after 31 minutes. They had 73 per cent possession and 21 shots, six on target, while preventing Aston Villa from registering a shot on target in a Premier League match for the first time since 2022. Brighton are seeking their first away Premier League win since beating Burnley on 11 April, having drawn one and lost two away games since. The Seagulls had the 14th best away record in the competition last season with 20 points from their 19 matches. Brighton have won only three of their past 21 Premier League games in London, drawing eight and losing 10, and have conceded exactly twice in four of their last five matches in the capital. Goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen was the only Brighton player to play every minute of their Premier League games last term. Welbeck and Joao Pedro have either scored or assisted seven of Brighton’s last 13 Premier League goals against Chelsea (54 per cent) - Welbeck with three goals and two assists, Joao Pedro with one of each. news.title_zh: 埃米·马丁内斯 (Emi Martinez) 确认切尔西队号码
news.body_en:
The Chelsea squad number Emi Martinez will wear following his transfer from Aston Villa has been confirmed.

 Martinez completed his switch to Stamford Bridge this morning. The 33-year-old, who lifted the FIFA World Cup with Argentina in 2022 and won the UEFA Europa League with Villa last season, has signed a three-year contract with the Blues. ‘It’s incredible,' Martinez said in his first interview as a Chelsea player, which you can watch above. 'It’s been an amazing few days. Obviously, it happened really quickly, but I'm delighted to be at this football club. 'I’ve been in England for nearly 17 years and to play for Chelsea is a dream for me. I’m just over the moon and can’t wait to get started.’ Martinez will now begin working with his new team-mates under Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso and when he represents the Blues for the first time, he will do so wearing our No.26 shirt. Buy your Martinez No.26 shirt now! It is a squad number that was most recently worn by Levi Colwill, but made famous at Stamford Bridge by John Terry, who worked with Martinez at Aston Villa. Supporters can buy their Martinez shirt now by clicking here!

news.title: Xabi Alonso explains how 'great influence' Danny Welbeck raises standards
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索解释“巨大影响力”丹尼·维尔贝克如何提高标准
news.body_en: Danny Welbeck has a history of scoring in fixtures between Chelsea and Brighton & Hove Albion. Thankfully, when the two sides meet tomorrow at Stamford Bridge, he will be trying to do so for the Blues. Before moving to the Bridge this summer, Welbeck spent six years with the Seagulls and became a thorn in the Blues' side.  He netted six goals and claimed two assists for Brighton in nine Premier League meetings with Chelsea, the most recent of which came in April. Welbeck displayed his goal-scoring instincts in a Chelsea shirt for the first time on Thursday. The 35-year-old was handed his debut in our Carabao Cup second-round tie against Luton Town, and he opened the scoring with a well-taken header. Whether Welbeck features in tomorrow's contest in west London is a decision for Blues manager Xabi Alonso. The Spaniard knows the qualities the striker provides – and is pleased Welbeck will not be lining up for Brighton on this occasion. 'I am aware [of his record in the fixture] and I am happy he is with us!' joked Alonso in his pre-match press conference. 'He has many qualities. As a player, you see how intelligent he is, and he links well. Out of the box, he is able to combine, and in the box he is very intelligent to be in the right place. We saw that [against Luton]. 'On a daily basis, he is a great influence for the rest of the players. He trains really hard and is raising all the standards in training. This is something we think is important.' While Welbeck and fellow summer arrival Jordan Henderson have brought a wealth of experience to the Blues squad, Alonso has been keen to stress the influence of several other players within the first-team group. 'They [Henderson and Welbeck] help but it’s not just them,' said Alonso. 'Reece [James], Maxence [Lacroix], Morgan [Rogers] as well. Even if they are younger, they have a good impact. 'That was a very important decision in the squad planning - that we were bringing players who add not just on the field, but are ready to compete and who don’t need much time to make an impact. We are happy with that.'
news.body_zh: 丹尼·维尔贝克有在切尔西和布莱顿之间的比赛中进球的历史。值得庆幸的是，当双方明天在斯坦福桥相遇时，他将努力为蓝军做到这一点。在今年夏天转会到蓝桥之前，维尔贝克在海鸥队效力了六年，并成为蓝军的眼中钉。  他在布莱顿对阵切尔西的九场英超比赛中攻入六球并贡献两次助攻，最近一次是在四月份。周四，维尔贝克首次身披切尔西球衣展现了他的进球本能。这位35岁的球员在卡拉宝杯第二轮对阵卢顿镇的比赛中首次亮相，他以一记漂亮的头球首开纪录。维尔贝克是否参加明天在伦敦西部举行的比赛将由蓝军主帅哈维·阿隆索决定。西班牙人知道这名前锋的能力，并且很高兴维尔贝克这次不会为布莱顿效力。 “我知道[他在比赛中的记录]，我很高兴他和我们在一起！”阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上开玩笑说。 “他有很多品质。作为一名球员，你会看到他是多么聪明，而且他的联系也很好。在禁区外，他能够进行组合，在禁区内他也非常聪明，能够处于正确的位置。我们在（对阵卢顿的比赛中）看到了这一点。 “在日常生活中，他对其他球员都有很大的影响。他训练非常刻苦，并且正在提高训练中的所有标准。我们认为这很重要。虽然维尔贝克和夏季新援乔丹·亨德森为蓝军带来了丰富的经验，但阿隆索一直热衷于强调一线队其他几名球员的影响力。 “他们（亨德森和维尔贝克）提供了帮助，但不仅仅是他们，”阿隆索说。里斯[詹姆斯]、马克森斯[拉克鲁瓦]、摩根[罗杰斯]也是如此。即使他们年纪还小，但他们的影响力还是不错的。 “这是球队规划中一个非常重要的决定——我们引进的球员不仅在场上，而且已经准备好参加比赛，而且不需要太多时间就能产生影响。我们对此感到高兴。

news.title: Nicolas Jackson departs Chelsea on permanent transfer
news.title_zh: 尼古拉斯·杰克逊永久转会离开切尔西
news.body_en: Nicolas Jackson has completed a permanent transfer from Chelsea to Aston Villa. The Senegal international arrived at Stamford Bridge in June 2023 from Spanish club Villarreal. Jackson was part of the Chelsea squads that won the UEFA Conference League and FIFA Club World Cup trophies. He netted 13 goals during that campaign, including one in the Wroclaw showpiece against Real Betis. The 25-year-old featured for the Blues under Xabi Alonso in pre-season, but now heads to Villa Park and brings an end to his time at Stamford Bridge. We thank Nico for his efforts during his time at the club and wish him well for the future.
news.body_zh: 尼古拉斯·杰克逊已经完成从切尔西到阿斯顿维拉的永久转会。这位塞内加尔国脚于 2023 年 6 月从西班牙俱乐部比利亚雷亚尔抵达斯坦福桥。杰克逊是切尔西队赢得欧洲联盟联赛和国际足联俱乐部世界杯奖杯的一员。在那场比赛中，他打进了 13 个进球，其中包括在弗罗茨瓦夫对阵皇家贝蒂斯的比赛中打进的一球。这位25岁的球员在季前赛中代表哈维·阿隆索麾下的蓝军出场，但现在前往维拉公园，结束了他在斯坦福桥的时光。我们感谢尼科在俱乐部期间所做的努力，并祝愿他未来一切顺利。

news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which of the Blues' players are must-haves, who the best value-for-money picks are, and why Joao Pedro (£7.6) is Chelsea’s most popular player. Cole Palmer (£9.5m) looked back to his best and delivered a differential 13-point haul for his 14% ownership. The Englishman added a second-half goal to his assist in the first minute on his way to securing maximum bonus points. Palmer was involved in everything going forward, racking up five shots and three chances created. His performance against Fulham will encourage Fantasy managers - Cole returned 244 points in 29 starts during the 2023/24 season, especially with other premium assets blanking on the opening weekend. The Blues’ two summer signings, Morgan Rogers (£7.5m) and Maxence Lacroix (£6.0m), have put themselves firmly on Fantasy managers’ radars. The former continued where he left off in Chelsea’s final pre-season friendly against Real Sociedad by scoring one of three shots he had at Craven Cottage. Rogers’ goal was assisted by Lacroix, who topped off a superb defensive display with an impressive assist, showcasing his offensive threat. The Frenchman also returned defensive contribution points, something he made a habit of doing last season in a Crystal Palace shirt. Unsurprisingly, Joao Pedro (£7.6m) is the highest-owned Chelsea player in FPL. The Brazilian currently sits in 67% of teams, second among all players. Over 290,000 managers have transferred in the Brazilian ahead of Friday’s GW2 deadline, resulting in a price rise of £0.1m, following his 11-point haul against Fulham. Joao Pedro, who was the only forward to score more than nine points in GW1, picked up a goal, an assist and claimed a share of the bonus points. Last season, the Brazilian returned 177 Fantasy points thanks to 15 goals and nine assists, his best-ever season across all three metrics. The underlying data for Joao Pedro in 2025/26 was equally impressive. No Chelsea player managed more shots (73), big chances (26) or Expected Goals (14.96). JP will be keen to impress against his old club Brighton on Sunday. The Seagulls are in UEFA Conference League action on Thursday. In defence, Josh Acheampong (£4.5m) played the full 90 minutes and returned defensive contribution points. No Chelsea player racked up more DefCons than the Englishman’s tally of 15, thanks to five tackles, seven clearances, two blocks and one interception. Acheampong is attractively priced if he can keep his place with Wesley Fofana (£5.0m) returning from suspension. On the other side of the back-three, Levi Colwill (£5.0m) also featured. The Englishman scored against his former club Brighton at Stamford Bridge back in the 2023/24 season. Bruno Fernandes (£12.0m) is likely to be the most captained player this weekend for Manchester United’s home match against Ipswich Town. Despite a disappointing result in Gameweek 1, the Red Devils’ captain registered three shots and three chances created against Hull. With penalties and other set-pieces in his locker, Fernandes carries explosive potential for Gameweek 2. Elsewhere, Erling Haaland (£15.5m) will be looking to get off the mark against Crystal Palace on Friday night after blanking on the opening weekend. Last season’s Golden Boot winner racked up 239 points in 25/26 thanks to 27 goals, eight assists and 43 bonus points. The Norwegian’s underlying numbers were encouraging against Bournemouth, with a match-high five shots and a 0.74 xG tally.

news.title: National League Cup report: Wycombe Wanderers Women 0-6 Chelsea Women's Under-18s
news.title_zh: 国家联赛杯报告：韦科姆流浪者女足 0-6 切尔西 18 岁以下女足
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s made a superb start to their senior Women’s National League Cup campaign with a commanding 6-0 victory away at Wycombe Wanderers Women Chelsea N'Drin opened the scoring from the penalty spot on the half-hour and the Blues then struck five times after the interval, as Tess Finn, N'Drin again, Carla Gardiner, Maisie Brickell and Rebekah Pierce also found the net. Leanne Champ's side created a host of chances and dealt impressively with the physicality of their senior opponents, combining sharp transition play with composed finishing while keeping a clean sheet. Chelsea were made to work for the opening goal by a physical Wycombe side, but our youngsters continued to create chances and our positive play down the right was rewarded after 30 minutes. Gabi Storey, Keira Johnson and Brickell combined before the latter drove into the penalty area. Brickell skipped beyond three Wycombe players and was eventually brought down, leaving the referee to point to the spot. N'Drin stepped up and converted with power and placement into the corner, giving Chelsea a deserved lead that we carried into the interval. The Blues resumed with real purpose and doubled the advantage two minutes into the second half. Storey and Johnson combined on the right, with the latter delivering a low cross into the area. N'Drin's first effort was blocked, but Jahyma Putman recovered possession and spun before finding Finn on the edge of the box. The midfielder drove forward and finished across goal. Chelsea's reaction to a Wycombe throw-in brought the third goal on 57 minutes. Brickell won the first contact high up the pitch and Johnson controlled the ball before turning and releasing N'Drin on the right side of the area. The forward spotted the goalkeeper advancing from her line and produced a composed chip to claim her second goal. Gardiner was introduced in place of N'Drin after 65 minutes and needed only one minute to make an impact. Patient build-up play was recycled to goalkeeper Freya Weeks, whose long diagonal pass cleared the Wycombe defence and found Putman. Her early cross was met first time by the arriving Gardiner to make it 4-0. Chelsea added a fifth on 81 minutes after reacting quickly to regain possession in the middle third. Gardiner found Pierce on the left and the substitute drove inside before playing through Wycombe's defensive line for Brickell, who supplied a composed finish. There was still time for one final goal in the second minute of stoppage time. Chelsea won the first and second balls from a long Wycombe goal-kick, allowing captain Belle Sullivan to combine with Finn in midfield. Finn passed into Pierce's forward run and the substitute advanced into space before sending a superb long-range finish dipping beneath the crossbar. The emphatic victory puts Chelsea at the top of Group D after the opening round of Women's National League Cup fixtures, with two group matches remaining. Chelsea return to Professional Game Academy South League action on Sunday 30 August, when Crystal Palace visit. Chelsea Women Under-18s (4-3-3): Freya Weeks; Elise Christian, Sophie Leach, Gabi Storey (Sadie Gregory 72’), Zoe Ciccardini; Belle Sullivan (c), Tess Finn, Keira Johnson; Jahyma Putman (Rebekah Pierce 72’), Chelsea N'Drin (Carla Gardiner 65’), Maisie BrickellUnused subs: Bella BartlettScorers: N'Drin 30 (pen), 57; Finn 47; Gardiner 66; Brickell 81; Pierce 90+2Manager: Leanne Champ
news.body_zh: 切尔西 18 岁以下女足在女子国家联赛杯成年组比赛中取得了出色的开局，客场以 6-0 大胜韦科姆流浪者队女足，切尔西·恩德林在半小时内通过点球破门，蓝军随后在中场休息后五次进球，苔丝·芬恩、恩德林再次进球，卡拉·加德纳、麦茜·布里克尔和丽贝卡·皮尔斯也进球。 Leanne Champ 的球队创造了很多机会，并以令人印象深刻的方式应对了高级对手的身体素质，将敏锐的转换进攻与沉着的射门相结合，同时保持不失球。威科姆队的体力让切尔西队首开纪录，但我们的年轻球员继续创造机会，我们在右路的积极表现在 30 分钟后得到了回报。加比·斯托雷、凯拉·约翰逊和布里克尔联手，后者带球进入禁区。布里克尔跳过了三名威科姆球员，最终被放倒，让裁判指向了现场。恩德林挺身而出，在角球中充满力量和位置，为切尔西赢得了当之无愧的领先优势，我们将其带入了中场休息。蓝军恢复了真正的目标，并在下半场两分钟后将优势扩大了一倍。斯托里和约翰逊在右路联手，后者低传到禁区。恩德林的第一次射门被挡出，但贾希玛·普特曼重新夺回控球权并旋转，然后发现禁区边缘的芬恩。中场球员向前推进并越过球门完成射门。第 57 分钟，切尔西队对韦科姆掷界外球的反应带来了第三个进球。布里克尔赢得了球场上的第一次接触，约翰逊控制了球，然后转身释放了禁区右侧的恩德林。这位前锋发现了守门员从她的防线上推进，并做出了一个冷静的射门，攻入了她的第二个进球。加德纳在 65 分钟后取代恩德林上场，只需要一分钟就产生了影响。守门员弗雷亚·威克斯（Freya Weeks）耐心地组织进攻，她的长对角传球突破了威科姆的防守，找到了普特曼。她的传中第一次被到达的加德纳接住，将比分改写为4-0。切尔西在第 81 分钟迅速反应，在中场重新夺回控球权后，再进第五球。加德纳在左侧找到皮尔斯，替补球员突破内线，然后突破韦科姆的防线，为布里克尔打进一记沉着的射门。伤停补时第二分钟，还有时间打进最后一球。切尔西通过韦科姆的长距离球门球赢得了第一个和第二个球，让队长贝尔·沙利文与芬恩在中场联手。芬恩传球给皮尔斯的前插，替补球员推进到空位，然后在横梁下方送出一记精彩的远射。这场大胜让切尔西在女子国家联赛杯首轮比赛后以 D 组榜首的身份晋级，目前还剩下两场小组赛。切尔西将于 8 月 30 日周日重返职业比赛学院南联赛，届时水晶宫将作客。切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 (4-3-3)：Freya Weeks； Elise Christian、Sophie Leach、Gabi Storey（Sadie Gregory 72’）、Zoe Ciccardini；贝尔·沙利文 (c)、泰丝·芬恩、凯拉·约翰逊； Jahyma Putman (Rebekah Pierce 72'), Chelsea N'Drin (Carla Gardiner 65'), Maisie Brickell未使用的替补：贝拉·巴特利特得分手：N'Drin 30（点球），57；芬兰人 47；加德纳66；布里克尔81； Pierce 90+2经理：Leanne Champ

news.title: Jorja Fox leaves Chelsea
news.title_zh: 乔贾·福克斯离开切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea can confirm defender Jorja Fox has today completed a permanent move to Ipswich Town. Fox joined the Chelsea Academy at the age of eight and made her senior debut for the Blues in a 4-0 away victory against Aston Villa in the 2020/21 campaign. Later that season, she made her first start in a 5-0 win over London City Lionesses. Her first professional contract with the club came in August 2021, on the day she turned 18. Loans to Charlton Athletic, Brighton and Hove Albion and Crystal Palace followed as she gained experience at senior level. Fox signed a contract extension with Chelsea in August 2024 and last season joined Newcastle United on a further loan. On the international stage, Fox represented England at every youth level during her time with the Blues. Everyone at Chelsea would like to wish Jorja every success in her future career.
news.body_zh: 切尔西确认后卫乔贾·福克斯今天已永久转会至伊普斯维奇。福克斯八岁时加入切尔西青训学院，并在2020/21赛季客场4-0战胜阿斯顿维拉的比赛中首次代表蓝军出场。那个赛季晚些时候，她在 5-0 战胜伦敦城狮队的比赛中首次首发。她与俱乐部的第一份职业合同于 2021 年 8 月签订，那天她年满 18 岁。随着她在高层积累了经验，她又被租借给查尔顿竞技队、布莱顿霍夫队和水晶宫队。福克斯于2024年8月与切尔西续约，上赛季进一步租借加盟纽卡斯尔联。在国际舞台上，福克斯在蓝军效力期间代表英格兰各个青年级别参赛。切尔西的每个人都祝愿乔雅在未来的职业生涯中取得成功。
